title: Applications Systems Analyst/Programmer
description:
## Applications Systems Analyst/Programmer
Location: Remote
## Contract Status: Pending Award
Notice: This position is contingent upon JCTM receiving a contract award and authorization to proceed. Employment opportunities and anticipated start dates are dependent upon contract award, government approval, and satisfaction of applicable onboarding and suitability requirements.
## The Challenge
What if your application development and systems analysis expertise could help improve the reliability and effectiveness of technology supporting millions of USCIS customer interactions? JCTM is seeking an Applications Systems Analyst/Programmer to support the continued operation, maintenance, testing, and enhancement of critical federal data and reporting systems.
## Build Your Career
At JCTM, we value knowledge, experience, integrity, and commitment. Joining our team means becoming part of an organization that empowers individuals, prioritizes ethical practices, and fosters a culture of collaboration and growth.
## Challenging Projects
As an Applications Systems Analyst/Programmer with JCTM, you will support the analysis, testing, maintenance, and enhancement of the USCIS Centralized Data Repository (CDR) and the OAIS Centralized Reporting System (OCRS) user interface. You will contribute to maintaining system functionality, improving application performance, documenting technical changes, and ensuring authorized users have dependable access to operational reporting information.
## Key Responsibilities
Application Analysis and Maintenance: Analyze, test, troubleshoot, and maintain the CDR and OCRS user interface to support ongoing operational requirements.
Application Enhancements: Implement and test application improvements and system modifications requested and approved by USCIS.
System Integration: Support the integration of CDR/OCRS with reporting data sources, underlying databases, and associated applications.
Cloud Environment Support: Assist with application and database maintenance within the AWS-hosted environment.
User Access and Authentication: Support OCRS user interface functionality, including integration with USCIS Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) Single Sign-On (SSO).
Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: Identify application defects, investigate system performance issues, and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.
Security Maintenance: Support the identification and remediation of application security findings, including required patches and upgrades.
Testing and Quality Assurance: Perform functional testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing in coordination with USCIS and other technical stakeholders.
Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain application documentation, technical procedures, user guides, and records of system modifications.
Change Management: Document and coordinate approved technical changes using USCIS project management and collaboration systems, including Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
System Support: Collaborate with technical teams, government personnel, and external vendors to maintain continuous system functionality and support operational improvements.
## State-of-the-Art Technology
Expand your expertise through hands-on support of AWS-hosted applications, cloud-based data repositories, SQL databases, identity and access management integrations, and enterprise reporting interfaces.
## New Skills
Collaborate with application developers, systems administrators, business analysts, and government technical personnel while gaining experience in federal enterprise systems, cloud application support, system security, and software lifecycle management.
## Room to Grow
You will have opportunities to grow your career and contribute to the company's strategic goals, supported by mentorship and a collaborative work environment.
## You Have
• Associate's degree or higher.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in the Information Technology field.
• Ability to analyze, test, troubleshoot, and maintain information technology applications.
• Ability to support application enhancements, technical documentation, and system maintenance activities.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and government stakeholders.
## Nice to Haves
• Experience supporting web-based applications and enterprise reporting systems.
• Familiarity with AWS cloud infrastructure and Amazon S3.
• Experience with SQL databases, queries, or database maintenance.
• Familiarity with application development, debugging, and software testing methodologies.
• Experience integrating applications with SSO or ICAM solutions.
• Experience using Jira, Confluence, or SharePoint.
• Familiarity with federal information security requirements, Section 508 accessibility standards, and application change management.
• Previous experience supporting DHS, USCIS, or other federal government IT environments.
## Clearance
Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to applicable government information and systems. This position requires a satisfactory USCIS Enter-on-Duty (EOD) determination prior to beginning work and the ability to obtain and maintain the required government suitability determination.
## Compensation
JCTM is committed to fair and transparent compensation practices. The anticipated compensation for this position will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, which may include the candidate’s relevant education, training, certifications, security clearance and access requirements, years and depth of relevant experience, specialized skills and qualifications, position level, assigned responsibilities, work location, applicable contract or customer requirements, internal equity, and the approved compensation budget for the position. Where required by applicable state or local law, JCTM will include the applicable good-faith salary or hourly pay range, along with any required information regarding benefits and other compensation, in the job posting.
## Equal Opportunity Employer Statement
JCTM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

You'll build and own the custom middleware that connects AI voice platforms (Vapi, Retell, Assistable within GoHighLevel) to field service management systems like ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro, so live phone conversations turn into accurate, booked jobs on a contractor's dispatch board. Beyond the build, your mission is reliability: proactively testing and monitoring voice agents so contractors get zero downtime and high booking accuracy, documenting the systems in clear SOPs, and laying the technical groundwork for upcoming enterprise industry partnerships in 2027. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you'll work directly with the founder and grow into technical leadership as the team expands.
If you're a proactive, code-first engineer who loves building voice agents and integrations that actually work in the real world, and you take pride in systems that never miss a call—this role could be a great fit for you. ✨
✅ Qualifications:

• 💻 Real Coding Skills– Strong JavaScript and/or TypeScript; you write, review, and debug your own code (no "vibe coding"). Comfort reading .NET / C# / C++ environments is a big plus.
• 🔌 APIs, Middleware & Integrations– Proven experience building middleware and integrations using REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and SDKs.
• ⚙️ GoHighLevel Expertise– Solid experience building workflows, automations, and sub-account setups in GoHighLevel (GHL).
• 🤖 Automation & Agent Frameworks– Experience with n8n, Hermes Agents, Composio, OpenClaw, or similar automation and agentic AI platforms.
• 🔐 Security-Minded– Solid grasp of API security, data privacy, credential vaults, VPNs, and VPS hosting.
• 💬 Clear Communication & Ownership– Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable supporting clients directly, and able to work independently without constant supervision.
## Nice-to-Haves:

• 🧠 Advanced AI Concepts– Familiarity with RAG, MCP, and vector databases.
• 🌐 Web & Marketing Tech– Website builders, hosting, landing pages, Google Business Profile, and AEO/SEO automation.
• 🧑‍💻 Software Engineering Background– Software engineers or full-stack developers who have moved into AI automation and voice agents are an ideal match.
Responsibilities of the AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration):
## Your responsibilities include:
• 🔌 Middleware & Field Service Platform Integrations
• Build and maintain custom middleware connecting AI voice platforms (Vapi, Retell, Assistable within GoHighLevel) to Field Service Management (FSM) systems
• Integrate with platforms like ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro using REST APIs and OAuth
• Write integration logic that interfaces with .NET / C# / C++ backend environments

• Code, review, and debug custom application logic in JavaScript and/or TypeScript
• 🎙️ Voice AI Agent Engineering & Tuning
• Build, configure, and maintain production-grade voice agents using Vapi, Retell, Assistable, and ElevenLabs
• Fine-tune latency, test prompt frameworks, design agent harnesses, and curate dynamic knowledge bases
• Architect multi-step decision trees and parent-child logic (e.g., distinguishing a tenant from a commercial property manager during an emergency call)
• Run automated tests on conversational accuracy, speech recognition, and intent categorization to catch bugs before clients do

• ⚙️ Omnichannel & Back-Office Automation

• Implement automations using platforms such as Hermes, OpenClaw, Composio, and n8n

description:
About Mission Underwriting Services
At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. We offer non-recourse capital for qualified underwriters, giving you a manageable risk profile with potential equity upside. By taking care of administrative complexities like compliance, risk management, accounting, and HR, we free you to focus on what you do best underwriting and distribution. Our turnkey platform gets you into the market in just a few months, minimizing disruption to your key relationships. With access to our network of highly rated issuing carriers and reinsurance partners, you can secure coverage with less stress and uncertainty. Built from the ground up, our purpose-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.
What We Offer:
• Remote First Work Environment (US Based)
• Medical, Dental, Vision
• 401K, 401K Match
• Life and Disability Benefits
• Unaccrued Paid Time Off
• 11 Paid Holidays
• Employee Discounts
• Employee Assistance Program
• Educational Assistance Program
• Employee Referral Program
• Paid Parental Leave
Purpose:
Mission is seeking an MLOps and AI Infrastructure Engineer to build and operate production-grade infrastructure across our agentic AI platforms. This hands-on role sits at the intersection of cloud engineering, DevOps, AI platform operations, and AI governance. The successful candidate will ensure that our AI infrastructure is secure, observable, scalable, resilient, auditable, and ready for enterprise production use.
This role owns the engineering practices that move AI workloads safely from development through production, including deployment automation, CI/CD, cloud security, monitoring and observability, incident response, model and agent lifecycle controls, model drift detection, and governance evidence. The role partners across engineering, data, product, security, and business teams to establish repeatable production-readiness standards across all three platforms.
Essential Duties/Functions:
AI infrastructure and production readiness
• Define and implement production-readiness standards for the agentic AI platforms, covering deployment, security, observability, reliability, scalability, resilience, cost management, rollback, and auditability.
• Design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and resilient AI infrastructure across Azure and AWS.
• Establish reference architectures, environment standards, landing-zone patterns, and governance controls for agents, models, data, APIs, and platform components.
• Partner with engineering and product teams to identify operational and governance risks early and move prototypes into production safely.
DevOps, deployment, and CI/CD
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, applications, models, prompts, agents, configuration, and supporting services across development, test, and production environments.
• Create reusable Terraform and Bicep modules with version control, peer review, automated validation, and policy-as-code controls.
• Automate testing, security checks, approvals, artifact versioning, environment promotion, release controls, and rollback procedures using Azure DevOps and Bitbucket Pipelines.
Security, governance, and risk controls
• Implement identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, network security, vulnerability management, configuration controls, and secure-by-default platform patterns.
• Operationalize AI governance through model and agent inventories, version tracking, approvals, risk assessments, documentation, lineage, access controls, and audit evidence.
• Partner with security, legal, compliance, and risk stakeholders to translate governance requirements into technical controls and repeatable operating practices.
Monitoring, observability, and model operations
• Implement end-to-end monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards, and audit trails for AI platforms and their dependent services.
• Monitor availability, latency, throughput, errors, data quality, model performance, token and cloud costs, security events, and user-impacting failures.
• Establish controls for model, data, and concept drift, prompt and configuration changes, degraded output quality, and unexpected agent behavior.
• Define thresholds, escalation paths, and remediation procedures for retraining, redeployment, rollback, and incident response; lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
Networking, resilience, and scalability
• Design and operate cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, firewalls, DNS, load balancing, private endpoints, and secure service-to-service communication.
• Implement backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and failover strategies appropriate to AI workloads and business-critical services.
• Plan capacity and performance and implement horizontal and vertical scaling while managing service limits, reliability, and cost.
Technical insights and business partnership
• Provide technical direction, standards, code and architecture review.
• Work effectively with business, delivery, product, data, security, and engineering stakeholders to communicate readiness, risk, dependencies, and tradeoffs.
• Stay current with cloud, MLOps, AI platform, and governance practices and recommend improvements that strengthen production readiness.
Required Qualifications:
• Five or more years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, MLOps, or AI platform engineering across AWS and Azure.
• Professional-level architecture certification in both AWS and Azure is preferred.
• Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Bitbucket Pipelines, and CI/CD for production systems.
• Strong experience with Terraform, Bicep, infrastructure as code, version control, peer review, and policy as code.
• Experience with cloud security, IAM, networking, secrets management, encryption, vulnerability management, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
• Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting, tracing, observability, and auditability for distributed systems.
• Practical MLOps or AI platform operations experience, including deployment, versioning, performance monitoring, drift detection, and rollback.
• Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI, data privacy, model risk management, and audit or regulatory compliance.
• Experience supporting business users or working in a forward-deployed, customer-facing, or similarly stakeholder-intensive technical role.
• Ability to deploy, operate, and troubleshoot APIs across Azure and AWS.
• Experience delivering AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, machine learning, or agent frameworks.
• Ability to deploy and manage Databricks environments in Azure using infrastructure as code.
• Strong problem-solving, written and verbal communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Cloud architect certification or equivalent architecture experience.
• Experience with containers and orchestration, including Docker and Kubernetes.
• Experience with observability platforms and practices for distributed applications and AI workloads.
• Experience with model registries, experiment tracking, evaluation frameworks, feature management, or AI platform services.
• Experience with OAuth, JWT, API management, gateways, and secure service integration.
• Experience building data pipelines and analytics solutions using Python, SQL, and Spark is a plus
• Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and capacity planning.
• Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated environment.
• Experience with Agile, DevOps, automated testing, and continuous improvement practices.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
• Strong knowledge of cloud architecture, MLOps, infrastructure as code, DevOps, and production operations.
• Ability to design production-ready AI infrastructure and translate AI governance requirements into measurable technical controls.
• Ability to use monitoring and observability signals to identify model drift, AI quality issues, reliability risks, and operational bottlenecks.
• Strong understanding of security, privacy, risk management, auditability, and responsible AI practices.

title: Network Architect Cloud & AI Infrastructure (m/w/d)
description:
## Über uns:
Wir sind Yorizon:Als Vorreiter für nachhaltige Green-IT-Cloud-Lösungen setzen wir auf digitale Souveränität. Wir sind eine Tochter von HOCHTIEF und bauen eine europäische Cloud-Plattform nach europäischen Sicherheitsstandards, die vollständig in unseren eigenen Rechenzentren läuft.
Open Source ist unsere DNA: Wir engagieren uns aktiv in Open-Source-Verbänden, Netzwerken und Kooperationen, um offene Standards mitzugestalten und die digitale Souveränität Europas mit innovativen IT-Lösungen zu fördern. Unsere Mission ist es, Unternehmen jeder Größe gemeinsam mit unserem Partnerökosystem dabei zu unterstützen, ihre digitale Transformation zu beschleunigen und ihre Geschäftsziele durch den Einsatz nachhaltiger Cloud-Technologien zu erreichen.
Start-up-Spirit trifft Konzern-Power:Yorizon ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von HOCHTIEF. HOCHTIEF ist ein technisch ausgerichteter, globaler Infrastrukturkonzern mit führenden Positionen in seinen Kernaktivitäten Bau, Dienstleistungen und Konzessionen/Public-Private-Partnerships (PPP) und mit Tätigkeitsschwerpunkten in Australien, Nordamerika und Europa. So verbinden wir agilen Pioniergeist und flache Hierarchien mit der Stabilität eines internationalen Konzerns.
## Dein Wirkungsbereich:
Als Netzwerkarchitekt (m/w/d) im Team Data Center Operations entwirfst Du das Netzwerk unserer Cloud. Es reicht vom Spine-Leaf-Fabric über Multi-Tenant-Netze in OpenStack und Kubernetes bis zu GPU-Clustern für AI-Workloads, und das über mehrere Rechenzentrumsstandorte hinweg. Du legst fest, wie unser Netz heute und in drei Jahren aussieht, und arbeitest dabei eng mit unseren Plattform- und Operations-Teams zusammen.
## Deine Rolle:
Architektur & Design:Du entwirfst skalierbare, hochverfügbare Netzwerkarchitekturen für unsere Multi-Datacenter-Umgebung auf Basis von OpenStack und Kubernetes.
Multi-Tenancy:Du gestaltest mandantenfähige Netzwerke mit Neutron/OVN sowie Container-Networking mit CNI-Plugins wie Cilium oder Calico.
High-Performance-Netzwerke für AI:Du planst Netzwerktopologien für GPU-Cluster mit RoCE, InfiniBand und lossless Ethernet und optimierst sie für verteiltes Training und latenzkritische Anwendungen.
Multi-DC-Strategie: Du verantwortest Inter-DC-Connectivity, Geo-Redundanz, Failover-Szenarien sowie Disaster-Recovery- und Business-Continuity-Konzepte.
Performance & Betrieb: Du sorgst für Verfügbarkeit, Performance und Sicherheit des Netzes, unter anderem durch Load-Balancing, Traffic-Engineering, QoS und Kapazitätsplanung.
Technologieauswahl: Du bewertest neue Netzwerktechnologien und Standards und triffst fundierte Entscheidungen, gerne auch für offene Lösungen wie SONiC.
Wissen teilen:Du erstellst Architekturdiagramme, Standards und Best-Practice-Leitfäden, berätst Entwicklungs- und Operations-Teams und gestaltest Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen mit.
## Das bringst Du mit:
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Architektur und Betrieb von Netzwerken in Rechenzentren. Du hast physische DC-Infrastruktur selbst geplant und betrieben, nicht nur Cloud-Netze bei Hyperscalern konfiguriert. Ob Du dafür ein Informatikstudium oder einen anderen Weg gegangen bist, ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was Du kannst.
• Fundiertes Know-how in modernen DC-Architekturen (Spine-Leaf/CLOS) und Routing mit BGP und EVPN-VXLAN
• Erfahrung mit Netzwerkvirtualisierung in OpenStack (Neutron, OVN/OVS) und/oder Kubernetes (CNI, Network Policies, Ingress)
• Praxis mit Automatisierung und Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Python, Ansible, Terraform, GitOps
• Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Netzwerkthemen verständlich zu erklären und Entscheidungen sauber zu dokumentieren
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
• Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen zu unseren Rechenzentrumsstandorten
## Nice to have:
• Erfahrung mit GPU-Netzwerken: RDMA/RoCE, InfiniBand, GPUDirect, NVLink/NVSwitch
Verständnis für die Netzwerkanforderungen von verteiltem AI-Training (NCCL, MPI, All-Reduce)
• Erfahrung mit SONiC, P4 oder anderen SDN-Ansätzen
• Erfahrung mit 100G/400G Ethernet und optischen Netzen
• Monitoring mit Prometheus, Grafana oder ELK
• Zertifizierungen wie CCIE, CKA oder NVIDIA NCP, die für uns aber kein Muss sind
## Unser Angebot:
Teamspirit:Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen, wachsenden Teams mit echter Du-Kultur. Wir bieten dir den Freiraum, deine Talente aktiv einzubringen und die Zukunft des Unternehmens mitzugestalten.
Karrierechancen: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Nutze die vielfältigen Aufstiegschancen in einem expandierenden Umfeld und profitiere von unseren spannenden internationalen Perspektiven.
Remote first:Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Arbeite 100 % remote aus Deutschland oder Österreich oder hybrid an unseren Standorten in Berlin, Augsburg oder Wien.
Deine Entwicklung:Wir investieren in dich. Mit einem eigenen Weiterbildungsbudget entscheidest du selbst, welche fachlichen oder persönlichen Skills du als Nächstes vertiefen möchtest.
Equipment: Damit du Bestleistungen bringen kannst, bekommst du das passende Werkzeug. Wähle frei zwischen modernsten Apple- oder Windows-Geräten.
Mobilität:Wir bezuschussen dein Deutschlandticket, damit du entspannt und nachhaltig unterwegs bist.
Wellbeing:Mit Wellpass nutzt du tausende Fitnessstudios, Schwimmbäder, Yoga- und Wellnessangebote in ganz Deutschland, ganz flexibel nach deinem Geschmack.
Zeit für dich:Freu dich auf 30 Urlaubstage. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns zusätzlich komplett frei.
Purpose: Für dein ehrenamtliches Engagement bekommst du einen zusätzlichen freien Tag.
## Bereit für die Herausforderung?
Du willst das Netzwerk einer souveränen europäischen Cloud von Grund auf mitprägen, von der Fabric bis zum GPU-Cluster? Dann bewirb Dich bei uns. Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

We work best as a team, knowing that collaboration leads to innovation and the best customer experience. We are looking for hardworking colleagues to join us and help us stay at the forefront of the energy industry, which is where we’ve been for over 150 years.

Sprague takes a collaborative, customer-centric approach to providing best-in-class energy products and related services throughout the Northeast. title: Data Engineer / Analytics Engineer confirmé — BigQuery & dbt
description:
## Description et livrables de la prestation
## Contexte :
Dans le cadre d’un projet de décommissionnement de SAP BW, une organisation renforce son équipe Data Platform pour concevoir, industrialiser et optimiser ses pipelines de données sur Google Cloud.
Les données sources sont déposées sous forme brute dans BigQuery via SAP Datasphere. La mission porte principalement sur leur transformation en modèles analytiques fiables, performants et exploitables pour les usages décisionnels.
## Livrables attendus :
• Pipelines de transformation développés avec dbt dans BigQuery.
• Modèles analytiques structurés et documentés.
• Tests de qualité intégrés aux traitements.
• Développements versionnés et intégrés au processus CI/CD.
• Documentation technique et d’exploitation.
## Missions principales :
• Concevoir et développer les transformations de données sous BigQuery à l’aide de dbt.
• Structurer les modèles selon une architecture en couches de type médaillon : données brutes, données nettoyées et harmonisées, puis modèles analytiques.
• Traduire les règles de gestion définies avec les interlocuteurs métier et techniques en transformations SQL.
• Optimiser les performances et les coûts des traitements BigQuery, notamment par le partitionnement, le clustering et les stratégies de chargement adaptées.
• Mettre en place des tests et des contrôles de qualité des données.
• Industrialiser les développements en appliquant les bonnes pratiques de versionnement, de revue de code et d’intégration et de déploiement continus.
• Contribuer à la fiabilité des pipelines et à l’analyse des anomalies.
• Documenter les modèles de données, les transformations et les procédures d’exploitation.
• Selon les besoins, contribuer à l’exposition des données dans Looker à l’aide de LookML.
## Expertise souhaitée
## Profil recherché :
Vous disposez d’une expérience significative en Data Engineering ou Analytics Engineering et savez intervenir de manière autonome au sein d’une équipe Data Platform.
Vous faites preuve de rigueur dans la conception, les tests et la documentation. Vous êtes capable de comprendre les besoins métier, de clarifier les règles de transformation et de collaborer avec les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles.
## Compétences requises :
• Maîtrise du SQL avancé et de la modélisation analytique.
• Expérience confirmée de BigQuery : développement, optimisation des requêtes, partitionnement et clustering.
• Expérience confirmée de dbt : modèles, dépendances, tests et documentation.
• Maîtrise de Git et des pratiques CI/CD appliquées à la data.
• Capacité à concevoir des traitements maintenables et fiables en production.
## Compétences appréciées :
• Premières connaissances de Looker / LookML.
• Expérience de projets de migration d’entrepôts de données ou de refonte décisionnelle.
• Familiarité avec les environnements SAP BW ou SAP Datasphere.

title: Java Developer |  Remote
Cloud Engineer
description:
## Overview
CPI Card Group is seeking a Cloud Engineer with a DevSecOps focus and hands-on experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS), AWS Security Services, infrastructure automation, to join the Infrastructure Cloud Engineering team. This role implements, automates, and operates secure, resilient infrastructure capabilities across a hybrid environment that includes on-premises environments, AWS Infrastructure as a Service, and relevant SaaS integrations.
The position strengthens the Cloud Engineering organization with a focus on AWS Cloud Security, and associated security services, infrastructure delivery pipelines, threat-detection integration, vulnerability and configuration remediation, data-protection controls, incident response, and compliance-control implementation. The engineer contributes to reusable infrastructure patterns, standards, guardrails, and automated controls that integrate security throughout the platform engineering and CloudOps lifecycle.
Working closely with Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, and other technology teams, this role translates security and compliance requirements into implementable infrastructure capabilities. This role is accountable for incorporating AWS Cloud Security controls within the scope of Infrastructure Cloud Engineering and associated infrastructure cloud platforms. Enterprise cybersecurity architecture, security policy, and cyber-risk governance remain with Cybersecurity.
## Responsibilities
AWS infrastructure security: Engineer and operate security capabilities supporting multi-account AWS environments, including logging, configuration compliance, threat detection, vulnerability visibility, network protection, encryption, and data protection. This work leverages AWS-native services such as AWS CloudTrail, AWS Config, Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, AWS Security Hub, AWS Shield Advanced, and AWS KMS.
Infrastructure as Code and automated controls: Develop and maintain Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, scripts, modules, policies, and automated workflows that provision secure infrastructures and platforms while continuously validating required security controls.
Secure delivery pipelines: Implement and improve infrastructure delivery pipelines, including security testing, policy checks, approval controls, separation-of-duties requirements, artifact integrity, and controlled promotion across environments.
Secure infrastructure patterns and standards: Implement and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure patterns across AWS and hybrid integrations using approved architectures, standards, and guardrails.
Threat, vulnerability, and risk reduction: Automate the identification, prioritization, tracking, and remediation of infrastructure vulnerabilities, insecure configurations, and control gaps. Provide technical evidence and remediation support for risk-management activities.
Hybrid infrastructure protection: Integrate security controls across on-premises environments, AWS infrastructure, and relevant SaaS services. Support network segmentation, security groups, firewall integration, DDoS-resilient designs, secure connectivity, and infrastructure protection patterns.
• Security monitoring and response: Improve infrastructure telemetry, alerting, and operational response through AWS and enterprise monitoring platforms. Participate in security and infrastructure incidents, root-cause analysis, containment, recovery, and corrective-action automation.
Compliance implementation and evidence: Partner with Cybersecurity to translate PCI DSS and other applicable control requirements into technical controls, validation methods, documentation, and repeatable audit evidence. CloudOps and platform operations: Monitor infrastructure health, security posture, reliability, and control effectiveness. Participate in lifecycle management, change management, problem management, operational readiness, and the team's 7x24 on-call rotation.
Collaboration and documentation: Contribute to design reviews, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing. Communicate options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical, non-technical, and leadership audiences.
Continuous improvement: Evaluate relevant AWS services and industry practices, pilot improvements within approved guardrails, and reduce manual work through safe, measurable automation.
## Qualifications
Builds for operations: Designs infrastructure with day-two operations in mind. Monitoring, alerting, patching, backup, and recovery are part of "done," not added later.
Builds security in: Treats security controls as engineering requirements that are coded, tested, and validated in the pipeline, not as reviews applied after deployment.
• Automates first: Prefers code over console changes. Spots repeated manual work and turns it into automation that is versioned, reviewed, and repeatable.
Troubleshoots across layers: Diagnoses issues that span AWS, networking, identity, on-premises systems, and SaaS integrations. Uses logs, metrics, and security findings to find the root cause, not just the symptom.
Works with operational discipline: Follows change management and approved standards. Leaves systems and runbooks in a state another engineer can support during an on-call event.
Respects ownership boundaries: Understands what Cloud Engineering owns and what belongs to Cybersecurity and Technology Governance, Risk and Compliance, and knows how to engage those teams effectively.
Exercises risk-aware judgment: Recognizes when a design, request, or shortcut creates unacceptable risk. Raises it with evidence and a recommended option, explained in plain terms for engineers, auditors, and leaders.
Keeps learning: Keeps AWS, security, and automation skills current and applies what they learn to improve team patterns and practices.
## Requirements:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or comparable professional experience.
• Three or more years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud security engineering, or comparable technical roles.
• Hands-on experience deploying, securing, and operating AWS infrastructure in production or regulated hybrid environments.
• Experience implementing or improving security controls within production cloud or hybrid infrastructure.
• Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, with experience developing reusable modules, automated testing, policy validation, and controlled deployment practices.
• Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms and source control, such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS-native delivery services.
• Strong scripting or software automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or a comparable language.
• Experience with multi-account AWS environments, identity and access controls, logging and monitoring, configuration compliance, vulnerability management, encryption, data protection, and network security.
• Experience participating in infrastructure or security incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action implementation.
• Working knowledge of regulated-industry security and compliance practices. Experience with PCI DSS is preferred.
## Preferred Certification and Qualification Paths:
Candidates may demonstrate readiness through one or more of the following paths. AWS certifications are preferred; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered: Preferred path: An equivalent combination of AWS architecture, operations, security, automation, and production engineering experience aligned to the following certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate
Additional desired qualifications: AWS certifications or equivalent experience aligned to: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional AWS Certified AI Practitioner

title: Python Programmer/Data Analyst
description:
Why RTI
RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.
We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.
## About the Hiring Group
RTI’s Center for Data Interoperability is seeking dynamic and detail-orientated candidates for a full-time Programmer/Analyst with Python or SQL analytic programming experience. The Programmer/Analyst will work with researcher teams to analyze and synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative administrative health data from multiple sources into meaningful results. Individuals in this role will provide analytic development and statistical programming knowledge to project teams conducting research using healthcare data, especially large and complex health insurance claims and survey data, in a fast-paced environment.
This position is based in Research Triangle Park, NC or any other U.S. location as a telecommuter.
## What You'll Do
## Core responsibilities:
## Approximately 85% of working time will require:
• Developing coding expertise and best practices to query, merge, and analyze complex healthcare data from large relational databases
• Leveraging a variety of quantitative methods to standardize, blend, and distill data from multiple disparate sources, transforming them into analytic insights for use in client reports, journal manuscripts, abstracts, or posters for professional meetings
• Iteratively developing and maintaining Python code while adopting best practices for increasing efficiency, minimizing computational errors, implementing process improvements, and other approaches that add value to business processes and analytic results
• Participating in thorough code review and documentation, as well as parallel coding efforts for other programmers to maintain quality standards and ensure that code may be efficiently transferred among team members as needed
• Constructing analytic datasets and databases to support deliverables for various public health and healthcare financing engagements
• Collaborating with project team members to review, critically evaluate, and refine business requirements, and then translate those requirements into programming logic
• Adopting and refining technical skills on projects, including working independently, proactively resolving day-to-day issues of small complexity, and leveraging coding best practices and standards
## Approximately 15% of working time will require:
• Participating in continuing education courses on healthcare-related and/or technical coding topics (including learning new coding languages) as applicable to the role and evolving business needs
• Sharing insights gained from the above activities with fellow programmers, leaders, and other division staff through activities such as presentations at staff meetings, contributions to collective codebase utilities, and training early career staff
## What You'll Need
## Minimum Qualifications:
• BS/BA or advanced degree in data science, computer science, statistics, social sciences, health policy or related field with at least 3 years of programming experience OR the equivalent combination of education and experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience is defined as a Master’s degree in the same areas mentioned above and at least 1 year of relevant experience
• Minimum of 3 years of experience with Python or SQL analytical coding with demonstrated familiarity with the linkage of various types of data files
• Programming experience using data stored in relational databases such as Teradata, Snowflake, DB2, Oracle, and SQL Server
• Experience designing and implementing flexible, reusable, scalable, programming code
• Commitment to analytic programming quality and best practices, including experience with QA/QC procedures (e.g., peer review of code, parallel programming)
• Familiarity with all phases of the Analytic Development Life Cycle and demonstrated experience in working with at least 1 of these phases
• Organizational and planning skills that enable independent work while contributing to a team effort
• Analytic thinker with exceptional attention to quality and detail
• Good interpersonal skills, including written and oral English-language skills, the ability to effectively manage competing deadlines, and the ability to work independently on a day-to-day basis while regularly collaborating with project teams
• Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, have lived in the United States for at least 3 of the last 5 years, and should not require now, or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status
## Preferred Qualifications:
• At least 1 year of experience using SAS for analytic programming
• Demonstrated understanding of relational database management concepts
• Healthcare industry experience, analytic experience in work with the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and/or knowledge of healthcare terminology and taxonomy/classification systems (e.g., ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS)
• Programming experience within CMS data systems such as the Integrated Data Repository (IDRC), Chronic Conditions Warehouse (CCW), or Centralized Data Repository (CDR)
• Understanding and use of issue tracking and code versioning tools such as Jira or Git

title: Java Back-End Developer |  Mid
Tabular AI Solution Architect
description:
## The role
You are the technical voice of Probabl in front of US data science teams: the person who takes a first conversation to a technical discovery, a demo on their own problem and a scoped proof of concept, alongside the sales team. Services owns technical pre-sales and delivery; you bring that field engineering expertise to the sales team on every US opportunity.
Probabl is the Tabular AI company founded by the creators of scikit-learn. Skore, our platform, builds, validates and tracks predictive models on tabular data with the methodology of the scikit-learn maintainers built in. Data science is being rewritten by agents faster than the discipline can absorb it; our job is to keep the science guarding the speed.
This is our first Solution Architect in the US. You join the Services team, Probabl's applied AI team of field engineers and solution architects, and work day to day with our US sales lead. Our pre-sales practice already runs in France, with a Solution Architect, a reference demo, a demo kit and a PoC playbook. You run it for the American market and feed back what you learn, so the whole team's practice gets better.
## What you'll do
Run the demo.Own the reference Skore demo for the US and adapt it to a prospect's use case in days, with the demo kit, on your own.
Run technical discovery. With data science leads and their platform teams: current stack and tooling, how models are built and validated today, where reliability leaks, what a first project would look like.
Scope the PoC.Turn a qualified opportunity into one scoped question on the customer's data, with a clear go/no-go, then hand it to our field engineers to deliver.
Run workshops and hackathons. Hands-on sessions with a prospect's data science team on their own data, and the occasional hackathon with partners or schools: the fastest way to show what Skore does and to qualify a team.
Answer the hard questions. Architecture, security, deployment options (on-prem, BYOC, cloud), how Skore fits an existing stack. You bring Engineering in when needed, not by default.
Work the deal with Sales.Technical qualification, RFPs and evaluation workshops, alongside our US sales lead.
Bring the field back to Product. What US customers ask for, what blocks a deal, what wins it: written up, sized, and fed into the roadmap every week.
## What you bring
5+ years in data science or ML engineering, then pre-sales or solutions work for a data or AI product. You have built models in production and you have sold the idea of building them better.
You master tabular data work end to end, whatever the framework: scikit-learn of course, but just as much gradient boosting, PyTorch, time series and the like, with the evaluation and validation that go with them. You can read a prospect's pipeline, spot the leakage, and show them in a notebook what a sound evaluation looks like.
You run a room. A live demo to 20 data scientists, a whiteboard with a platform team, a discovery call with a VP: you adjust and you land the point.
You are comfortable with enterprise buying groups: data science, IT and security, procurement, and the economic buyer, each with their own question.
Based in the US, remote, with travel to customers and periodic trips to Paris.
Strong plus: experience with agentic or LLM-based data science tooling, and a healthy skepticism about its outputs.
Nice to have: Kubernetes and cloud basics, tabular and time series foundation models (TabICL and others), an open-source footprint in the Python data ecosystem.
## Why Probabl
Credibility you don't have to build. scikit-learn is downloaded over 200 million times a month. You walk into every room with the stewards of the library behind you.
A category, not a feature. We are defining Tabular AI: AI on the structured business data that runs companies, with the scientific method built in. You help define what it means in the US.
A team that builds its playbook together.We have a first version of our demos, PoC playbook and processes, and they still have a lot of room to evolve. You use them with US customers and improve them with the rest of the team.
Short distance to the product. Solution Architects and field engineers sit in a weekly Product–Services sync. What you hear from customers changes the roadmap, visibly.
## Practical
Reports to the VP Services (Paris). Day to day with our US sales lead, who is fully involved in the hiring.
Location: United States, remote. Preferred time zone: East Coast (to confirm). Travel to customers as needed; two to three trips a year to Paris, including onboarding.
Compensation:fixed + variable tied to pipeline and closed deals; band to confirm.
Start:as soon as possible.
Process, three weeks from first call to offer:
## 30-minute call with the VP Services.
## 30-minute call with our US sales lead.
## Practical evaluation
## 30-minute call with a co-founder.
## Offer.

title: Data Analyst II
description:
## Position Summary
The Data Analyst II is a capable analytical contributor who independently designs, executes, and delivers data analysis and visualization work across RS21's client engagements. This role is designed for a practitioner who can take an analytical question from problem definition to client-ready findings without day-to-day direction, make sound methodological choices within established frameworks, and communicate results clearly to a range of audiences, technical and non-technical alike.
This person works confidently across RS21's analytical toolchain, produces high-quality reporting and dashboards, applies statistical methods appropriately, and adapts rapidly to the needs of each client context. They are able to provide constructive feedback to junior analysts, contribute to RS21's analytical documentation, and are actively deepening their expertise in the areas that will define their senior-level contribution.
This role is embedded in real client delivery and expected to take full ownership of assigned analytical workstreams. The Data Analyst II does not wait for scope to be handed down; they clarify requirements, propose analytical approaches, flag methodological risks, and keep delivery moving. They understand that the best analysis is the one that is used long after the engagement ends, and they design their work accordingly.
Critically, the Data Analyst II is developing into the kind of analyst RS21 depends on across engagements: someone who delivers accurate, timely, and persuasive analytical work, communicates with genuine client-centricity, and brings enough self-awareness to know when a question requires a methodology or domain expertise that they need to develop.
## Key Responsibilities
## Data Analysis and Insight Delivery
• Independently design and execute analytical projects across multi-source datasets; manage data extraction, transformation, quality assessment, and exploratory analysis without requiring direction on approach.
• Write clean, functional Python or R code for data analysis, automation, and reporting tasks; apply software discipline including version control, notebook documentation, and reproducibility practices.
• Write complex SQL queries independently; optimize performance, choose appropriate query patterns by workload, and communicate query logic clearly in documentation and code review.
• Apply statistical techniques including regression, significance testing, sampling methodology, and descriptive analysis to produce findings that are both technically sound and interpretively honest about uncertainty.
• Independently design and publish production dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent; connect to multiple data sources, apply sound visualization and UX principles, and govern data model and access design.
• Independently produce compelling data narratives using storytelling tools and visualization frameworks for diverse client and stakeholder audiences; adapt depth, format, and framing to the audience.
## AI-Augmented Analytics
• Use AI productivity tools independently to meaningfully accelerate research, analysis, and reporting tasks; apply sound judgment about when AI assistance improves work and when it introduces risk.
• Apply AI-assisted data preparation and pattern detection within established analytical workflows; validate AI-generated outputs critically before incorporating them into client deliverables.
• Stay current on emerging AI-augmented analytical tools and share relevant learnings with the analytics team; help the practice understand where these tools add genuine value.
## Client and Stakeholder Engagement
• Manage stakeholder relationships independently for assigned engagements; facilitate analytical meetings, communicate findings clearly, navigate competing interpretations, and keep stakeholders aligned on scope and timeline.
• Produce high-quality client reports, analytical briefings, and status communications; tailor content to audience and ensure clients have the information they need to act on analytical findings.
• Apply established data governance frameworks in client environments, including documenting ownership, lineage, and metadata, under the direction of an engagement lead.
• Anticipate evolving client analytical needs and proactively communicate concerns about scope, data quality, or methodological limitations before they become delivery risks.
## Data Quality and Documentation
• Independently validate analytical outputs for accuracy, reproducibility, and appropriate handling of data limitations; document assumptions, caveats, and quality decisions clearly so reviewers and downstream users can trust and build on your work.
• Maintain high-quality analytical documentation in Confluence or equivalent; structure documentation so teammates unfamiliar with an engagement can understand what was analyzed, how, and what it means.
• Contribute to reusable analytical templates, code libraries, and accelerators that help the team move faster on common problem types.
## Collaboration and Mentorship
• Provide structured support to junior analysts through hands-on coaching, code review, documentation, and pairing; help them develop the technical and communication habits that will carry them toward independent contribution.
• Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to ensure analytical work connects to the right data assets and model outputs; understand the full data flow well enough to design analysis around it.
• Partner with project managers to keep analytical delivery aligned with client expectations and contractual constraints; surface scope and timeline risks early with enough context for leadership to act.
## Qualifications
## Required
• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Public Policy, or a related quantitative field.
• 3 to 5 years of progressive experience in data analysis or business intelligence, including independent delivery of analytical projects from problem definition through client presentation.
• Proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical language (Python or R), including libraries for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and visualization.
• Advanced proficiency with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent BI platforms; able to design, publish, and govern production dashboards independently.
• Strong grounding in applied statistics including regression, hypothesis testing, sampling methodology, and uncertainty quantification.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including written reports and live presentations.
• Experience managing stakeholder relationships and delivering analytical work independently across client engagements.
## Preferred
• Experience with geospatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS, QGIS, or Python-based spatial libraries.
• Background in advanced analytics, program evaluation, or government data environments.
• Familiarity with longitudinal data, panel data methods, or quasi-experimental evaluation designs.
• Basic understanding of cloud data platforms such as AWS Redshift, Google BigQuery, or Snowflake.
• Background in consulting or multi-client delivery environments where analytical standards and client communication expectations are high.
• Familiarity with AI-augmented analytics tooling and responsible approaches to integrating generative AI into analytical workflows.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
About Us
Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.
We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!
We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.
About The Role
The Cloud Engineer role is critical to scaling Chess.com's infrastructure to support millions of daily chess games and serve global users. This position combines site reliability engineering expertise with cloud infrastructure management, directly impacting system performance, reliability, and scalability across Chess.com's multi-regional distributed architecture. The role requires deep technical expertise in both infrastructure automation and application optimization to maintain Chess.com's position as a high-traffic gaming platform while enabling rapid feature development and deployment.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Architect and optimize cloud-native infrastructure using Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitOps tools to support millions of concurrent chess games across multiple global regions
Lead performance optimization initiatives by analyzing Golang and TypeScript codebases to identify and resolve bottlenecks at scale, with specific focus on chess programming optimizations
Design and implement multi-regional resilient systems capable of handling extreme scale challenges including managing 1 million+ CPUs across dozens of regions
• Run and evolve our private Kubernetes cloud on bare-metal: a Rancher-managed fleet in our own datacenters that carries compute and IO intensive workloads, operated as one platform with GKE regions, with workloads placed wherever they get the best cost and performance.
Execute incident response and operational excellence serving as primary technical resource for critical infrastructure issues, ensuring rapid resolution and minimal downtime
Develop high-performance integration patterns for distributed systems handling extensive data volumes while maintaining reliability and scalability targets
Collaborate with development teams to implement cloud service integration best practices and optimize application deployment architectures
Implement Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform to manage all cloud resources, ensuring consistent, automated, and scalable deployment processes
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitOps approaches using tools like ArgoCD to enable rapid, reliable software delivery
Monitor and enhance system observability through implementation of modern monitoring stacks including Prometheus, Mimir, ES, Vector and Tempo
Qualifications
7+ years of experience managing large-scale, cloud-native distributed systems with proven ability to handle high-traffic production environments
Expert-level proficiency with Kubernetes including cluster deployment, management, and advanced orchestration patterns
Advanced Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform for managing complex cloud and Kubernetes resources in production

title: Research Scientist - Generative Audio
description:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
• Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
• Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
• Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.

We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/
## What You'll Do
Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.

title: Full Stack Web Engineer
description:

Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria's Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.
Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.
## Your Role
This role sits at the intersection of ML engineering and computational physics, working within our Software Engineering & Digital Twin environments. You'll collaborate closely with optical engineers, laser and fusion physicists, simulation scientists, and systems engineers to embed data-driven intelligence directly into our Digital Twin architecture. You’ll be reducing design risk, shortening development timelines, and unlocking system-level optimization that purely physics-based approaches can't achieve at the speed we need.
You will design, build, and deploy machine learning models that enhance, accelerate, and augment our multiphysics simulation environments across our high-energy laser systems, target injection and tracking system, target manufacturing system, and fusion chamber. This will enable faster design cycles, predictive system optimization, and real-time decision support across our laser, targetry, and fusion programs.
## What You'll Do
Surrogate & reduced-order modeling: Design and deploy surrogate and reduced-order models (ROMs) that replace or accelerate high-fidelity multiphysics simulations in the Digital Twin environment
Physics-informed ML: Develop physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that embed physical constraints (Maxwell's equations, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics) directly into model architectures
ML pipelines: Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, validation, uncertainty quantification (UQ), and continuous model refinement against experimental and simulation data
Active learning & Bayesian optimization: Implement active learning and Bayesian optimization workflows to intelligently guide design space exploration and reduce costly simulation runs
Digital Twin integration: Integrate trained ML models into the broader Digital Twin framework, interfacing with HPC simulation outputs (COMSOL, ANSYS, custom solvers) and real-time sensor data
Anomaly detection: Develop anomaly detection and predictive diagnostics models to monitor system health and identify off-nominal behavior in laser subsystems
Autonomous optimization: Apply reinforcement learning and Bayesian control approaches to support autonomous or semi-autonomous optimization of laser operating parameters
Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate with Digital Twin architects, systems engineers, and optical simulation scientists to ensure ML models meet fidelity, latency, and uncertainty requirements
Engineering rigor: Establish best practices for model versioning, reproducibility, testing, and documentation in a fast-moving research environment
## Who You Are

title: Research Scientist – Foundation Models and Multimodal AI
description:
ABOUT US

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany.

Please submit your CV in English




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 We are seeking a driven Research Scientist with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform.

In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems.

 


IN PARTICULAR, YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

 - Model adaptation and optimization: Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies.

 - Multimodal integration: Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers.

 - Pipeline and evaluation engineering: Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance.

 - Applied R&D collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows.

 - Low-hanging fruit innovation: Identify high-impact, incremental improvements in data pre-processing, embedding representation, and fine-tuning to maximize model performance without unnecessary computational overhead. 

 


ABOUT YOU

Required qualifications / experience:

 - Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.

 - Experience: 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets.

 - Foundation models: Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models.

 - Multimodal learning: Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models.

 - Technical stack:
   
   - Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem).
   
   - Hands-on experience with fine-tuning techniques.
   
   - Familiarity with data engineering tools for handling large-scale or multi-modal datasets (Parquet, AnnData, HDF5).

 Preferred qualifications/bonus:

 - Experience working with biological or omics data (e.g., scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, clinical and/or histology data).

 - Experience deploying or scaling models using containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

 - Track record of open-source contributions or peer-reviewed publications at top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR) or domain-specific journals.

 

 #LI-HB1


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Flexible work organization

 - Friendly and informal working environment

 - Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds


RECRUITMENT PROCESS & SECURITY

title: OpenText Workflow Backend Developer – Operations Orchestration (DevOps Team)
description:
Role summary
Full-stack backend developer in an Agile DevOps team that builds and runs automation on OpenText Operations Orchestration (OO). Designs, develops, and maintains OO flows, operations, and content packs in OO Studio, automating IT and business processes and integrating OpenText with enterprise systems. Owns the stability of these automations in production, and supports the team's move of selected workflows to ServiceNow by documenting and explaining existing OO logic.
Job Description or Responsibilities
Flow development in OO Studio
• Design, build, and maintain flows and subflows in OO Studio (and OO Workflow Designer where used), covering inputs, outputs, results, transitions, and responses.
• Develop custom operations using Java, Python/Jython, PowerShell, SSH, SQL, and HTTP/REST operations.
• Build reusable flows and operations, and apply consistent naming, structure, and versioning standards.
• Configure system accounts, system properties, selection lists, and configuration items securely, avoiding hard-coded credentials and environment values.
• Build robust error handling, retries, timeouts, and logging into flows so failures are clear and recoverable.
• Automate IT processes such as user provisioning, server and cloud operations, patching, monitoring remediation, and service request fulfillment.
Content packs
• Develop, package, and version custom content packs, and manage dependencies on OpenText base and integration content packs.
• Upgrade out-of-the-box content packs, test impact, and fix broken flows after upgrades.
• Promote content packs across dev, test, and production through OO Central, following the team's release and change process.
• Manage content in source control (Git/SVN with OO Studio SCM integration).
Integrations
• Build integrations between OO and enterprise systems, such as ServiceNow, Active Directory/Entra ID, VMware, monitoring tools, databases, and ticketing systems.
• Build and consume REST/SOAP APIs, including authentication (OAuth 2.0, basic auth, API keys, certificates).
• Configure and maintain Remote Action Servers (RAS) and worker groups for executing operations across network zones.
• Support triggers from other systems, for example SMAX processes, monitoring alerts, or schedules, and make sure results flow back correctly.
Full-stack development
• Develop backend services and scripts (Java, Python, PowerShell) that support automation.
• Build or maintain simple web front ends, APIs, or dashboards that start or report on automations where needed.
• Work with databases (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL) for OO data, reporting, and integration logic.
Operations (run)
• Monitor flow runs, schedules, RAS health, and OO Central, and act on failures before users are affected.
• Troubleshoot failed or stuck runs using run logs, debugger, and step-level details.
• Resolve L2/L3 incidents for the automations the team owns, within SLA, and turn permanent fixes into backlog items.
• Take part in the team's on-call or support rotation.
• Support OO platform upgrades, patches, and certificate renewals together with platform administrators.
• Maintain runbooks, flow documentation (purpose, inputs, dependencies, owners), and known-error records.
Migration support
• Document existing OO flows and integrations clearly, so the ServiceNow team can assess and rebuild them in Workflow Studio and IntegrationHub.
• Work with ServiceNow developers during migration waves, explaining flow logic, dependencies, and edge cases, and supporting side-by-side testing and cutover.
• Help decommission flows and content packs once replacements are live.
Experience and qualifications
• 4 to 8 years in software development or automation engineering, with at least 3 years of hands-on OpenText (or Micro Focus/HPE) Operations Orchestration development.
• Deep experience with OO Studio: flows, subflows, operations, system accounts and properties, and debugging.
• Proven experience building, packaging, and deploying content packs, and upgrading OpenText content packs.
• Strong scripting and programming skills in Java, Python/Jython, and PowerShell, plus SQL.
• Strong integration experience with REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, and authentication methods.
• Experience with OO Central administration basics and Remote Action Servers.
• Good knowledge of infrastructure: Windows and Linux, Active Directory, networking basics, virtualization, and cloud platforms.
• Experience troubleshooting production automation and doing root-cause analysis.
• Experience with source control (Git) and working in Agile DevOps teams.
• Understanding of ITIL processes, especially Request Fulfilment, Incident, and Change.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications
• Preferred: OpenText (Micro Focus) Operations Orchestration training or certification; ITIL 4 Foundation.
• A plus: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or Certified Application Developer (CAD), useful given the migration to ServiceNow; a cloud associate certification (AWS or Azure).
Nice to have
• Experience with OpenText Service Management (SMAX) Studio or Hybrid Cloud Management (HCMX).
• Experience with ServiceNow Workflow Studio or IntegrationHub.
• Experience with other automation tools, such as Ansible, Terraform, or RPA platforms.
• API testing tools such as Postman.

title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering
## About the Role
Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.
We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.
This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.
This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.
## What You'll Do
Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.
Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.
Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.
Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.
Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.
Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.
## What We're Looking For
Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.
Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.
Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.
An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.
High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.
Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.
Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.
Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.
Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.
## Why This Role Matters for You
Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.
Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.
From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.
Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.
San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.
