title: Applied AI Scientist - LLMs & Voice
description:
## Our mission
We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...
## How you'll help us achieve it
Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire, with millions of users, growing rapidly year on year. And, we’re still in the early days of our product roadmap and potential impact on people’s everyday lives.
We're helping millions of customers across West Africa access financial services through mobile money, and great support is fundamental to that. We believe the future of customer support lies in machines handling boring repetitive tasks so humans can focus on high value interactions that require empathy and creativity
As an Applied AI Scientist on our Support Automation product team, you will:
• Be responsible for driving the quality of our automated support through evaluating and improving everything the team builds
• Bridge research and production, building agent systems that ship into real products.
• Contribute to autonomous voice and digital agents that power 10M+ customer interactions per month across West Africa.
• Build for the hardest edge cases: poor connectivity, low literacy, and languages with little training data.
• Experiment with, evaluate, and integrate the latest voice and text models.
• Own problems end-to-end, from problem discovery to running in production, working alongside product and engineering leaders who prioritize shipping real customer impact.
If you're energized by ownership, thrive on deep technical challenges, and want to build infrastructure that serves millions in emerging markets, let's talk.
## Key Details
• This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (US, UK, Spain, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso.
• Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates.
• Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once a year. Exceptions apply, but we’ve found this key to understanding our users and product.
• Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $167,00 - $227,900 USD, plus a generous equity package.
• Major benefits:
• Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
• 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
• Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays.
• $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.
## Requirements
• 5+ years of experience in AI/ML experience
• Proven hands-on experience building with LLMs or AI systems (evaluation, RAG, embeddings, safety and guardrails etc.).
• Strong foundations in statistics and ML theory.
• Solid Python skills.
• Track record taking AI/ML systems from prototype to production and care deeply about reliability, performance, and scalability.
• Fluency with AI agents, with bonus points for deploying them as part of production systems
• Bonus points:
• Research background in speech or LLMs
• Proven Voice AI experience (ASR, TTS, latency optimization, real-time streaming, voice agents)
• Experience building customer support or conversational AI systems
• You follow the latest research in speech and LLMs, and know how to translate papers into production wins
• Familiarity with low-resource language challenges
• Building in high-risk agent environments like finance
• Fluent in English, (bilingual in French is a big bonus!)
## You might be a good fit if you
• Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and designing AI systems end-to-end without detailed specs
• Obsess over evaluation – you've built frameworks to catch hallucinations, measure groundedness, and know when to trust your system
• Balance research intuition with pragmatic engineering; you ship working systems, not just prototypes.
• Like working with large datasets, complex pipelines, and modern ML infra (distributed training, feature stores, monitoring, etc.)
## About engineering at Wave
We care about the big picture. We don’t hire engineers to just ship tickets. We hire them to solve problems. That means caring deeply about outcomes, understanding context, and jumping in wherever something’s broken, even if it’s technically “not your area.” When we see problems, inefficiencies, or opportunities to make something better, we act. We dig into operational issues, clarify fuzzy product specs, or step into unfamiliar code to help unblock teammates.
We move as fast as possible. Speed matters. It lets us try things quickly, get feedback early, and course-correct while it’s cheap. So we write small PRs. We aim for MVPs. We leave TODOs and file follow-ups. We don’t over-perfect v1. That said, we’re building a financial product. Some things—like money movement, correctness, or security—deserve more caution.
We like boring technology. We favor tools that are reliable, well-understood, and easy to debug. This keeps us focused on solving meaningful problems instead of wrestling with unpredictable infrastructure. If a new technology helps us move faster, build safer, or solve a real need, we’ll consider it. But we don’t adopt tools just because they’re new—we adopt them because they’re right.
Simplicity is a strategy. It lets us focus our energy where it matters most: serving our users.

## Our team
• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Driven Testing
description:
Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Driven Testing
We operate a regulated digital asset exchange, broker, and custodian serving institutional and professional investors. Our QA practice has been rebuilt around agentic AI: test planning, test code, failure triage, and even code review happens in partnership with AI coding agents, with the engineer as the human in the loop. We're looking for an SDET to join that team. Judgment, curiosity, and clear writing matter more to us than a perfect CV — if you're strong, we're flexible on the rest.
## What the role actually is
You won't spend your days hand-writing boilerplate test scripts. You'll direct AI agents to do the mechanical work, and your job is everything the machine can't be trusted with deciding what's worth testing, checking that a generated test can genuinely fail, spotting when a "passing" suite is lying, and judging whether a red run is a product bug, an environment problem, or a broken test.
## What you'll do
• Author and maintain automated UI and API tests (Playwright, TypeScript) covering the trading, custody, and customer-portal surfaces of the platform.
• Work with agentic AI tools daily — planning tests, generating code, triaging failures, reviewing PRs — and critically verify everything an agent produces before it ships.
• Triage nightly regression and smoke runs: separate genuine product bugs from environment noise and test-side defects, and file clear, well-evidenced bug reports that a developer outside your domain can act on.
• Keep the suite honest: link failing tests to known bugs, release them when fixes land, and never let a silent skip or a warning-instead-of-failure hide a real defect.
• Run and maintain suites in CI (GitHub Actions) and help keep the pipelines green, fast, and trustworthy.
• Keep test cases traceable in our test-case-management tooling.
• Occasionally cross the test boundary and fix what you find: QA works in the same monorepo as the product, so small bug fixes and improvements to the application itself are yours to ship, through the same PR and review process the developers use.
• Review teammates' test PRs — and respond to review findings on your own, including findings raised by AI reviewers — with evidence, not opinion.
• Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product owners across a globally distributed team.
## What we're looking for
• Hands-on experience in software testing, QA automation, or software development — typically 3–6 years, though we're flexible for the right person.
• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, or clear evidence you can pick a language up quickly.
• A solid grasp of how web applications and HTTP APIs work: requests and responses, status codes, JSON, authentication.
• Genuine interest in AI-assisted engineering. You should be comfortable making AI tools do real work — and sceptical enough to check the output. If you already use AI assistants for real tasks, we'll want to hear how.
• Excellent written English. In an agentic workflow, writing is the work: prompts, bug reports, test plans, and review comments all succeed or fail on clarity.
• Attention to detail and honest reporting. A failing test you explain truthfully is worth more to us than a green one you can't.
• Strong candidates usually bring several of the following — you don't need them all:
• Hands-on experience with Playwright (or Cypress/Selenium).
• Experience building or maintaining a shared test framework — fixtures, page objects, helpers, CI wiring — rather than only writing specs inside one.
• Exposure to financial services, trading, or capital markets — order lifecycles, settlement, custody concepts.
• WebSockets / real-time data, SQL/PostgreSQL, CI pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
• Familiarity with digital assets or blockchain.
## Nice to have
• Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or similar).

description:
SumerSports is a leading football intelligence technology company that specializes in providing an innovative suite of products for football fans and NFL clubs. We are a collection of executives, engineers, data scientists, and visionaries from NFL clubs, technology startups, finance, and academia.
Our data-driven platform empowers teams with insights and tools to make informed decisions within salary cap constraints. The platform also serves the NCAA, offering insights around the transfer portal and more.
What sets us apart is our unique blend of big tech talent, data scientists, and former NFL personnel, who have a combined 600+ years of NFL experience. Our domain knowledge is augmented by AI and machine learning technologies to create a unique view into many aspects of Football.
Position Summary
Our data engineering team is the foundation of this system, ensuring data is accurate, fast, and always available for our models and AI applications.
As a Data Engineer, you’ll design, build, and maintain the data pipelines that power our deep learning, video and LLM systems. You’ll work across ingestion, transformation, and orchestration layers — from real-time feeds to analytics-ready datasets. Your mission is to make data reliable, discoverable, and scalable for use by model training, analytics, and AI-driven products across multiple sports. You’ll collaborate closely with our MLOps, and Sports Data teams to ensure seamless integration between data and AI.
Responsibilities
• Build and operate robust data pipelines for ingestion, cleaning, and transformation using Databricks, Airflow, or Kubernetes.
• Develop efficient ETL/ELT workflows in Python and SQL to support both batch and streaming workloads.
• Partner with ML/AI teams to make datasets and tools discoverable and safe for autonomous agents, including evaluation and guardrails for AI-generated queries.
• Develop retrieval pipelines (RAG, vector search) over structured stats and unstructured sources (scouting notes, video metadata) to power AI applications.
• Model and maintain structured data assets (Delta, Parquet, Iceberg) for reliability, versioning, and lineage tracking.
• Implement orchestration and monitoring: schedule jobs, track dependencies, and automate recovery from failures.
• Ensure data quality and compliance through validation frameworks, schema enforcement, and audit logging.
• Contribute to data platform evolution: evaluate tools, standardize best practices, and improve developer experience.
• Support performance and cost optimization across compute, storage, and orchestration systems.
Qualifications
• 3–8 years of experience as a Data Engineer or ETL Developer in a production environment.
• Proficiency in Python and SQL; strong familiarity with Databricks, Spark, or equivalent big-data frameworks.
• Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Luigi or Prefect.
• Deep understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and distributed data processing.
• Knowledge of modern data lakehouse architectures.
• Familiarity with CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code, and data pipeline testing frameworks.
• Comfort working in a cross-functional environment with ML, product, and analytics teams.
• Exposure to LLM-powered data tools: text-to-SQL, RAG, agent/tool interfaces (e.g. MCP), or natural-language analytics.
• Previous work with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
Preferred
• Previous experience with sports, telemetry, or sensor data pipelines.
• Familiarity with streaming frameworks and event driven data processing (Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Flink).
• General knowledge of American football, the NFL, and college football.
• Background in data governance, lineage, and observability tools (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, Unity Catalog, OpenLineage).
• Experience designing semantic layers or metric definitions consumed by AI and BI tools.
• Exposure to best practices in machine-learning model management and MLOps.

Build Applied AI for Secure Mission Software
Help turn generative-AI concepts into dependable capabilities used within secure mission-planning and decision-support software.
At Rackner, you will integrate large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic AI, prompt-engineering workflows, and inference pipelines into an established software application supporting a high-impact national-security mission. You will work across AI, software engineering, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and customer technical teams to move capabilities beyond standalone demonstrations and into practical application workflows.

title: Software Engineer, Systems Architecture
description:
Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most - in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems-the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security.
Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it.
## About The Role
We're looking for a software engineer to own the architecture, data handling, and product layer of the software stack at one of Valinor’s product companies, currently in stealth. The system turns raw sensor data into a usable, trusted picture for the end user. You'll work directly with the General Manager and alongside a small team of engineers to rapidly develop a new product. You’ll also partner with product enablement at the Valinor Hub to stand up infrastructure and management.
We see this as a step-up role: someone who has already been part of building a system like this, whether embedded/edge software, sensor or data pipelines, or detection and classification work, as a strong contributor, and is ready to own that kind of architecture for the first time, with direct partnership from the GM on the highest-stakes tradeoffs.
## What You'll Do
1. Overall Software Architecture
Design the software architecture that ties the products data flow, processing, and user-facing product together end to end.
Define clean interfaces with the sensor integration and API work, so the pieces fit into a coherent whole rather than a collection of one-offs.
Make and document the core architecture decisions early, since the system needs to flex as we learn what the product needs to become.
2. Data Handling & Pipeline
Architect the edge vs. cloud processing split — what runs on-system under power/compute constraints versus what gets backhauled.
Stand up time-series and object storage systems for sensor and telemetry data, and the ingestion pipeline that gets data from the system to backend reliable.
Design for bandwidth-constrained, compression-aware data transport, and build in the data versioning and observability needed to trust what's flowing in as sensor types multiply.
3. Detection, Classification & Pattern-of-life
Work with various sensor modalities, including acoustic, EO/IR, radar, RF/AIS, and others, to build detection and classification capability — starting with classical signal-processing methods where appropriate, and applied ML where it earns its complexity.
Contribute to pattern-of-life anomaly detection work.
Fuse multi-modal signals into a single detection/classification output.
4. User Interface — Configuration & Visualization
Build the product configuration interface and the geospatial data visualization layer (the common operating picture) the end customer will actually use.
## What We're Looking For
Required
Architecture contribution, ready to lead: you've been part of a small team that designed and built a system with real architectural stakes — edge/embedded software, sensor or data pipelines, or similar — and you're ready to own that kind of system yourself for the first time.
Data pipeline and storage experience: comfortable designing and operating time-series data systems and message-based ingestion pipelines (MQTT, Kafka, or equivalent), including handling for intermittent/unreliable connectivity.
Full-stack range: comfortable moving between backend/data pipeline work (Python, Go, or similar) and frontend (React/TypeScript) without needing a specialist for each; enough familiarity with embedded/edge constraints to architect around them, even if you're not writing firmware yourself.
At least one sensing/signal domain: hands-on experience with at least one of acoustic, EO/IR, or radar signal processing or detection — and genuine excitement to pick up the others as the product grows into them.
Cloud infrastructure ownership: able to stand up and maintain CI/CD and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; GovCloud experience a plus) without a dedicated DevOps function yet in place.
Step-up temperament: proven ability to build and rebuild quickly with loose specs, and comfort taking ownership of a decision you'd previously have brought to someone else.
Strongly Preferred
TAK (or similar government system) integration experience: hands-on work integrating with TAK (ATAK/WinTAK/TAK Server) or a comparable government C2/situational-awareness system is a significant plus.
Applied ML experience, particularly anomaly detection or pattern-of-life modeling.
Prior experience in defense or dual-use tech, including familiarity with the general shape of DoD software requirements (security, data handling, eventual ATO/RMF processes).
Geospatial visualization experience (Mapbox, Cesium, deck.gl, or similar).
Prior experience on an autonomous systems, robotics, or maritime/subsea platform.
## What Valinor Offers
Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401K, development stipends, among others.
Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year.
We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey.
Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us.
This role requires the candidate be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Active clearance preferred, but not required.
Valinor is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Valinor team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals, who together are disrupting industry norms by creating new paths towards the future of defense and government technology. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process. If you are someone passionate about working on problems that have a real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Founding engineer, AI on CAD geometry (co-founder equity)
description:
LoopforgeLab enables machine and hardware makers make better design decisions by better we mean shorter design iterations, more sustainable products with less cost to manufacture and own.
We are building the Forge Engine is an agentic tool for manufacturing. Give it a BOM and a STEP file and it returns what the part costs to make and what the machine will cost to own over fifteen years, while there is still time to change the design. The lifecycle engine is built and runs on declared drivers. The agent already modifies geometry from natural-language instructions on our platform.
The next piece is the reason we are hiring. We need geometry reasoning that holds up on real customer CAD: feature recognition from B-rep, tolerances read per feature rather than per part, similarity against parts we have already costed, and an evaluation setup that shows whether the agent is improving or only sounding more certain. Also we need to build integrations with different CAD/ERP and PLM systems.
## What you would own:
The geometry reasoning module. Feature extraction from STEP, manufacturability signals, tolerance and surface finish handling.
The design agent’s optimisation loop. Iterating a design against a cost or lifecycle target rather than following instructions.
Evaluation. Benchmarks, regression suites, and the discipline to drop approaches that do not beat the baseline.
Architecture decisions with the founder, including when LLM reasoning beats rules and when it does not.
Reasoning Engine and live context retriever
## Who you probably are:
Strong experience with one of those: Python/Rust and C++ and real ML depth. You have built at least once in your life a geometric deep learning, GNNs, 3D representation learning modules in real production data settings and they're used by real users right now.
You have touched mechanical engineering for real. A degree, CAE/CAD/CAM work, manufacturing process knowledge, or a PhD near feature recognition, DFM or process simulation. You know why a tight tolerance on one face costs more than a loose one on five.
Comfortable with messy industrial data. Re-exported CAD that parses differently, BOMs with missing fields, 40 parts rather than 40,000.
You ship. Two-week demoable checkpoints rather than six-month research tracks.
Familiar with sustainability concepts and how do they be applied in the context of design and manufacturing
## Nice to have:
OpenCascade, PythonOCC, or commercial CAD kernel experience.
MCP servers, agent tooling, or LLM-in-the-loop CAD work.
Co-founder-level equity with standard vesting. You would be the third engineer in the room, which means you own things outright, including the parts nobody enjoys. We plan to open source what the community builds and put a private product layer on top.

description:
## About the Team
OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. For software engineering organizations, this means helping customers adopt Codex and other OpenAI capabilities across the software development lifecycle—transforming how teams plan, build, test, review, and deliver software.

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex, you will partner directly with leading engineering organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that transform how software is developed. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from workflow and use-case selection through prototyping, evaluation, production rollout, and scaled adoption.
You will work alongside engineering teams to build advanced AI coding workflows, integrations, automations, and evaluation systems—often using Codex itself as part of your development process. You will help customers make technical decisions involving model behavior, agentic workflows, developer environments, security, reliability, evaluation, and operational readiness, while ensuring deployments translate into measurable improvements in engineering productivity and software delivery.
You will work closely with OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Sales, and the broader Codex organization, translating real-world deployment experience into high-signal product and model feedback. This role is based in our Munich office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Create reusable architectures, tooling, examples, guides, and technical patterns—including contributions to resources such as the OpenAI Cookbook—that accelerate future Codex deployments.
Influence customer engineering strategy by helping technical leaders understand how AI coding systems can reshape their software development lifecycle, engineering practices, and organizational workflows.
## You’ll thrive in this role if you:
Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering software or AI systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; deep prior experience with OpenAI products is not required.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
## About us
People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.
Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.
Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.
## How we work
Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.
Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.
At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.
End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.
In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.
Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.
Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.
## The role
We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.
You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.
Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.
Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.
AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.
Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.
## What we look for
A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.
Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.
High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.
Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.
Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.
## Why join
You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success
Data Engineer 
 
About Mirakl
 
Mirakl is the leading provider of eCommerce software solutions. Mirakl's suite of solutions provides enterprises with a transformative way to drive significant growth and efficiency in their online business.
Since 2012, Mirakl has been pioneering the platform economy, empowering retail and B2B enterprises with the most advanced, secure, and scalable technology to digitize and expand product assortment through marketplace and dropship, improve efficiency in supplier catalog management and payments, personalize shopping experiences, and boost profits through retail media.
 
In July 2025, Mirakl launched Mirakl Nexus, the first neutral infrastructure designed for agentic commerce. Built on Mirakl's 13 years of expertise and innovation, and powered by an ecosystem of more than 100,000 sellers, Mirakl Nexus connects merchants and AI agents to automate product discovery, payments, and after-sales service.
 
For more information: www.mirakl.com.
 
This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris, with 4 days on-site per week.
 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Data Experience squad led by Alexandre Blanchard, Data Engineering Manager within Mirakl's broader Data team of 70 specialists. Together, you'll be building and scaling the ML infrastructure that powers Mirakl's AI-driven products from real-time recommendation inference to LLM fine-tuning pipelines serving some of the world's most innovative e-commerce players.
 

2. Your Impact

  • Design and implement a performant, robust, and scalable ML Platform architecture — covering training, evaluation, and inference — while keeping costs under control
  • Maintain and improve ML production pipelines and real-time inference applications at scale (real-time recommendation inference, 1M+ LLM calls/week, async content moderation)
  • Partner with Data Scientists from project kickoff through productionization — setting up best practices, guardrails, and CI/CD improvements in collaboration with the SRE team
  • Drive technical excellence: manage technical debt, systematize version upgrade processes, and upskill team members on MLOps and Data Engineering topics
  • Contribute to cutting-edge AI projects — including LoRA adapter creation for open-source LLM fine-tuning, in-house computer vision models, and large-scale product data transformation — and share findings across Labs teams
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 2+ years of experience in a Machine Learning and/or Data engineering environment
  • Proven track record of shipping ML applications at scale (NLP, image processing, or classical ML) in high-volume, production-grade systems
  • Background in software development with a strong appetite for data science and machine learning
Skills:
  • Proficiency in Python and the Kubernetes/Docker ecosystem
  • Solid experience with cloud environments (AWS primarily) and Apache ecosystem frameworks
  • Hands-on knowledge of an orchestration tool (Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and MLOps principles (monitoring, model lifecycle, reproducibility)
  • Strong communicator with a knack for mentoring and presenting technical work to diverse audiences
 

4. Tech Stack

Experience with: Python, Databricks, AWS, Kafka, Airflow, Prefect, MLflow, TensorFlow, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, KServe, Delta Lake, Kubernetes, SQL, Terraform, Apache Spark
 

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Fluent (B2/C1 level required) 
 

6. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.

AI is changing how we work, and we are at an important crossroads. We are exploring how AI can improve our business and looking for an intern who wants to learn, contribute and help turn ideas into action.
You do not need to have all the answers or be the most confident voice in the room. Bring your curiosity, practical skills and willingness to try.
With guidance from the Head of Sales & Strategic Partnerships, you will learn how the business works, spot opportunities and build solutions. Your questions and ideas could be the spark for change. We will give you space and support to develop them.
What you will do
An opportunity to join high level meetings to understand business needs and how teams work.
Identify where AI and automation could simplify tasks, reduce manual work or improve results.
Discuss ideas with your supervisor and build prototypes using AI tools, Python, automation platforms or other suitable tools.
Test solutions for accuracy and usefulness, troubleshoot issues and improve them based on feedback.
Demonstrate useful tools, prepare simple instructions and help colleagues adopt them.
Support everyday business tasks while looking for ways to improve them.
Handle business information with care and follow company guidance on approved tools and data use.
What we are looking for
Practical experience with AI. You have used AI tools to build a solution, automate a task or improve a process through coursework, personal projects or an internship.
Ability to build working solutions. You can use tools such as Python, automation platforms or AI APIs to turn an idea into something useful. Your experience goes beyond asking a chatbot questions.
Problem solving and testing skills. You can break down a task, troubleshoot issues and check that your solution produces accurate and useful results.
Initiative and follow through. You take ownership of tasks, explore options and seek guidance when needed. You refine your work until it meets the agreed need.
Clear communication and willingness to learn. You can explain what you built, how it works and its limitations. You listen to feedback and use it to improve.
What you will gain
Guidance, practical experience and room to build your confidence. You will work on real business challenges, develop your technical skills and help shape how teams use AI.
When applying
Please share an example of an AI or automation project you have worked on. Explain the problem, your contribution, the tools used and the result. A small, working project is enough to show us how you think and apply your skills.

title: Software Engineer, Profile & Community, Android
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
## The Community You Will Join
As an Android Engineer on the Profile & Community team within Airbnb’s Passport & Commerce organization, you’ll help build the social layer of Airbnb: a trusted social graph of real-world connections, the social features built on top of it, and the foundations that let people connect with the travelers they know and the people they meet along the way. The team is highly collaborative with its partners in design, product, data science, legal, and marketing to deliver features and experiences used by millions of people. We work closely with other engineering teams to ensure we build systems that are performant and configurable with architecture that's scalable and robust.
A typical day
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners such as Product Managers, Experience Designers and Engineers to design and deliver high-quality products on Android
• Deliver high-impact social initiatives end to end.
• Build efficient and reusable mobile components and architect reliable, performant, and scalable solutions
• Identify areas of improvement and drive mobile best practices
• Working closely with iOS and Web engineers on the team to develop foundational, cross platform solutions
## Your Expertise
• 3+ years’ experience developing Android applications at scale with a high volume of users
• Strong expertise building and maintaining high-performance and scalable consumer Android applications, preferably using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Experience with Motion and/or prototyping is a big plus.
• Extensive experience working with GraphQL and REST APIs
• You possess strong product sense and a passion for Android UI and UX product development
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Product Management, Design, and other iOS, Android, and Web Engineers
How We'll Take Care of You:
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
Pay Range
$162,000—$186,000 USD
Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Research Scientist, Discovery (Engineering & Applied Sciences)
description:
## About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
## About the role
The Discovery team at Anthropic is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist – a system capable of solving the long-term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific and technological frontier.
We're expanding our work on engineering and the applied sciences. Our goal is to contribute to training Claude to invent, design, and engineer across every discipline and scale, reliably and safely: new manufacturing and experimental techniques, processes, materials, devices, instruments, machines, energy systems, and factories. We want this work to accelerate science and technology and benefit people widely.
To achieve these goals, we're seeking exceptional machine learning researchers with deep expertise in training and evaluating frontier models. In this role, you'll work end to end across the model stack, developing training environments, rewards, data, and evaluations that measure and improve Claude's performance on complex engineering and scientific tasks, and carrying what works into production training runs. You'll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and partners across Anthropic and industry to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, and that learn from real-world feedback. A background in engineering or the sciences is a plus but not required.
## Key responsibilities
• Design, build, and study reinforcement learning environments, rewards, and training data that improve Claude's capabilities in engineering and the applied sciences
• Create benchmarks and evaluation frameworks that measure model performance on realistic engineering and scientific workflows
• Develop simulation-based training environments and verifiers, working with domain experts to validate them against real-world data
• Develop approaches to long-horizon task completion, multi-agent collaboration, and complex reasoning essential for real engineering and research work
• Research how models can learn efficiently from experiments and real-world feedback
• Study how environments and rewards behave in large-scale training, including robustness, calibration, and generalization, so that training produces models that are both capable and well aligned
• Scale research ideas from prototype to production training runs
• Collaborate with domain experts and industry partners to build and test what Claude invents, designs, and engineers, and turn that feedback into training and evaluation signal
• Help chart how Claude’s engineering capabilities reach real-world use: where they matter most, what stands in the way of adoption, and how that should shape research priorities
## Minimum qualifications
• Proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with a modern machine learning framework such as PyTorch or JAX
• Hands-on experience training or evaluating machine learning models
• Track record of machine learning research: forming hypotheses, designing and running experiments, and drawing sound conclusions from the results
• Ability to implement your own research ideas and diagnose problems in complex systems
• Ability to learn unfamiliar technical fields quickly and work productively with experts in them
• Clear communication and a collaborative approach to solving problems
• Excitement about improving Claude’s scientific capabilities and the downstream impact on science and technology
• Commitment to developing AI that is safe and beneficial
## Preferred qualifications
• Experience with reinforcement learning and pre-training on large language models, including environment and reward design
• Familiarity with large-scale language model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines
• Published research or practical experience in AI for science or engineering, or in long-horizon reasoning
• A degree or work experience in an engineering or applied science discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, materials, chemical, aerospace, systems, or manufacturing engineering, applied physics, or computational simulation
• Experience building simulators, surrogate models, or simulation-based environments and verifiers, and calibrating and validating them against real-world data
• Experience with large-scale data pipelines and technical or multimodal datasets
• Demonstrated ability to work across multiple domains, such as language modeling, systems engineering, and scientific computing
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
Annual Salary:
$500,000—$850,000 USD
## Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
## How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
## Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer, ChatGPT Finances
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The ChatGPT Finances team builds experiences that help people connect their financial accounts, understand their financial picture, and ask useful questions about their finances through ChatGPT.

Our work spans account connectivity, data ingestion, dashboards, personalized insights, and conversational experiences. We collaborate across product, design, research, infrastructure, security, and data integrations to make complex financial information understandable and actionable.

This is an early and ambitious product area with a substantial roadmap. We are looking for engineers who want to shape both the first user experiences and the durable systems required to earn and keep users’ trust.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for full-stack product engineers to build and scale ChatGPT Finances. You will own features across the stack—from polished frontend experiences to the APIs, services, and data models that power them.

This role is well suited to engineers who combine strong product judgment with broad technical depth. You should care about how quickly users can understand their financial lives, how reliably data moves through the system, and how AI can answer financial questions in a grounded, transparent, and useful way.

You will work closely with product, design, research, infrastructure, security, and data integration teams to take ideas from early prototypes to reliable production experiences.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Own full-stack product features from user experience and frontend implementation through backend services, data models, deployment, and observability.

 - Build polished, accessible, and performant interfaces for account connection, dashboards, insights, and conversational workflows.

 - Design APIs and backend systems that safely ingest, normalize, and serve financial data.

 - Build resilient integrations that handle synchronization, data freshness, partial failures, permissions, and user consent.

 - Bring new AI capabilities into production while prioritizing grounding, accuracy, transparency, and user control.

 - Establish architecture, performance standards, testing practices, and operational safeguards for a fast-growing product area.

 - Debug and improve complex behavior across client, server, infrastructure, and external integrations.

 - Use qualitative feedback, product metrics, and experiments to improve user outcomes without compromising clarity or trust.

 - Collaborate across disciplines to turn ambiguous product opportunities into simple, reliable experiences.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have experience building and shipping full-stack consumer products in production.

 - Are comfortable working in a modern frontend stack and building the APIs and services behind it.

 - Care deeply about product craftsmanship, performance, accessibility, and details that affect the user experience.

 - Understand API design, data modeling, system reliability, and the tradeoffs involved in evolving production systems.

 - Can move effectively between frontend, backend, and product decisions rather than remaining in a narrow implementation area.

 - Have strong product judgment and can take a feature from a rough idea to a shipped, measurable outcome.

 - Work well in ambiguous, high-impact areas where the product and technical architecture are still taking shape.

 - Think carefully about privacy, security, reliability, and user trust when working with sensitive data.

 - Enjoy diagnosing problems across system boundaries and improving the underlying engineering foundations.

 - Are interested in AI-native interfaces and new ways to make complex personal information easier to understand.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building backend services using languages and frameworks such as Python, Go, Node.js, or comparable technologies.

 - Experience with frontend development using React / Typescript, or Swift or Kotlin.

 - Experience operating consumer products or distributed systems at scale.

 - Experience with fintech, personal finance, banking, payments, investing, or sensitive-data domain.

 - Familiarity with authentication, identity, permissions, privacy, and secure data flows.

 - Experience building dashboards, data visualizations, or insight-oriented products.

 - Familiarity with observability, experimentation, product metrics, and iterative development.

 - Experience with applied AI, conversational interfaces, or systems that incorporate model-generated output.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Consumer Health
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s Health AI team is working to ensure that advances in AI meaningfully improve health for everyone. We build AI systems that help people better understand and navigate their health while setting a high bar for safety, reliability, privacy, and user trust.

On the Consumer Health team, we’re building health experiences directly into ChatGPT. People can use ChatGPT to understand health information, prepare for appointments, make sense of changes over time, and have more informed conversations grounded in their own health context.

Our work sits at the intersection of consumer product engineering, AI, and healthcare. We work closely with product, design, research, safety, privacy, and other ChatGPT teams to build experiences used at global scale.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for product-minded software engineers to build the next generation of consumer health experiences in ChatGPT.

You will own products and features end-to-end, from early prototypes through polished experiences used by millions of people. We welcome specialists in mobile, frontend, or full-stack development; you can focus on the area where you have the most depth.

This role is ideal for engineers who care deeply about craft and user experience, move quickly from idea to product, and are excited about making complex health information understandable and useful. Prior healthcare or AI experience is not required.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Design and build consumer health experiences across ChatGPT, including mobile, web, and full-stack product surfaces.

 - Own features end-to-end, from early product exploration and prototyping through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration.

title: Software Engineer in Test 5 - Discovery & Viewing Experiences
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
We’re hiring a senior Software Engineer in Test to lead how Netflix tests the experiences members use on their TVs and phones. You’ll define what quality means for complex, fast-moving features, build the tools and automation that prove it, and help every engineer around you ship with confidence.
## The Teams
Live UI
The Discovery and Viewing Experience (DVX) Live team owns the UI engineering and architecture that powers Live viewing experiences across TV, iOS, and Android. Members show up for live events once, with no second airing and no patch mid-show, so every feature we build is a promise that it will work at that moment on every device that tunes in. As our senior SDET, you’ll lead the way we test Live: recreating the moments a live event creates, like a vote opening just as an ad ends, long before the event does, so we know we’re ready instead of finding out during the show.
## What we’re working on:
• The FIFA Women's World Cup, coming to Netflix in 2027 and 2031, will feature new experiences built for global, multi-match sport tournaments.
• Interactive and navigational features that help members move through a live event and catch the moments that matter.
• Real-time voting, which lets members influence a live show as it unfolds, alongside millions of others watching at the same moment.
## Mobile Core
The DVX Mobile Core team develops and advances the architecture of Netflix's Android member app. We leverage systems and infrastructure widely available at Netflix and determine the best way to adopt and apply them on Android, enabling easier, more efficient patterns for downstream product engineering teams.
What we’re working on:
• Modernizing our app architecture for the iOS and Android member app. This involves driving migrations and a cross-platform Player rewrite, creating leverage for product teams to ship faster and more reliably on iOS and Android.
• Driving Quality of Experience (QoE). Owning monitoring and performance improvements across Player UI and canvases, as we scale.
## The Role
## Problem you’ll help solve:
• Testing and making sure millions of members see our Live-specific UI features and capabilities at the right moment, on every TV and phone.
• Giving every platform the same test plan, so TV, iOS, and Android are consistently validated the same way.
• Making tests reliable enough that PMs, designers, engineers, and our partners trust them, and fast enough to run on every change.
• Keeping quality steady while the iOS and Android apps modernize, including a cross-platform player rewrite, so faster delivery doesn’t come with more regressions.
## What you’ll do:
Lead testing for complex features across platforms.Agree on one test plan per feature that teams can trust and validate together, and implement it on TV, iOS, and Android, rather than reconciling differences afterward.
Build automation that people trust.Evolve our test systems and CI integration across platforms so tests are fast and reliable.
Make tricky live moments easy to test. Build ways to recreate them on demand instead of waiting for a real event, using mocks, overrides, real devices, and test data that looks like a real event and doesn’t expire.
Make large migrations safe.Build the test strategy that lets the iOS and Android apps modernize without regressions reaching members
Own quality metrics.Track how well we’re covered, how reliable our tests are, and which bugs reach members, and use that to decide what to improve next. That includes the client metrics that reveal problems only scale shows, and the alerts that tell us about them quickly.
Make sure bugs only surprise us once.When a bug reaches members, make sure it comes back as a test, using agents to turn each finding into several, and document how to test each feature so the knowledge doesn’t live in one person’s head.
Build and leverage AI tools.Act as a force multiplier to flag unwanted behaviors before they reach members, and apply agents to test authoring, failure triage, and bug analysis.
Shape testability from the first commit.Partner with engineers on architecture and code that are easy to test, and help them write better tests themselves.
Test where teams meet.Agree with partner teams on the contracts between our features and theirs, so end-to-end tests verify where teams meet and rehearse what members experience, rather than retesting every team’s systems.
Collaborate beyond the team.Work with partner teams on shared test data, environments, and tools, and with teams that run live events to ensure features are ready before showtime and can be safely switched off if needed.
Mentor and grow others,including engineers and SDETs, by reviewing test plans and test code, sharing practices, and making quality everyone’s job.
What we’re looking for:
• 8+ years of professional experience in software testing and test automation, with a strong record of leading testing for large, cross-team features or projects.
Comfort working across platforms. You’ve tested consumer apps on more than one platform, and you’re eager to learn the platforms you haven’t used yet.
Strong coding skills, with experience designing and building test frameworks and tools, not just writing test cases.
Experience or strong interest in using AI for testing, such as writing tests, triaging failures, or finding gaps in coverage, with clear ways to check its results.
• Deep experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and diagnosing flaky tests, infrastructure failures, and dependency issues.
• Experience with mocking, test data, or other ways to make hard-to-reproduce situations repeatable in tests.
• A practical, risk-based approach to quality: knowing where to invest in tests, which risks are acceptable, and when more testing isn’t the answer.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including explaining quality risks and trade-offs to engineers, product managers, and partners in terms they can act on.
• Alignment with Netflix's culture and values.
## Nice-to-haves:
• Experience with live streaming, video playback, ads, or other systems where split-second timing matters.
• Hands-on experience with testing frameworks on several platforms, such as Jest, Puppeteer, Espresso, or XCUITest.
• Experience driving shared testing infrastructure or quality strategies adopted by multiple teams.
• Experience testing how systems behave when things go wrong, such as chaos testing or failure drills.
Growth opportunities: We’re hiring a senior engineer, and we see this role growing into one that sets the standard for how Netflix tests its Live experiences and mobile apps at scale. Over time, you can:
Lead testing strategy across teams, creating the practices and tools that other teams adopt.
Shape client architecture for testability across platforms.
Influence partner teams' tooling and roadmaps, so our experiences are easy to test for everyone.
Mentor and grow engineers and SDETs across the organization.

description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.
## About the project
Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.
## About the roles
There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience& skillsets.
Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.
Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.
## Who we are looking for
Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.
Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language
Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.
Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.
## Project at a glance
Project duration: one week since the mid of November
## Languages: Dutch
Project time commitment: 6 hours per person
Project compensation: varies depends on different programming language
## Work location: fully remote
## How selection works (major steps)
Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.
Language test: short exercises in the target language.
Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.
Financial Onboarding & Role placement:complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.
Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

title: Software Engineer - AI Focus (Center for Technology in Education)
description:
The Center for Technology in Education in the School of Education at Johns Hopkins University seeks a Software Engineer - AI Focus to continue the development of AI-powered data tools for early intervention programs. In this role, the Software Engineer extends the build of an interactive dashboard that helps Part C teams explore their Child Outcomes Summary (COS) data and receive guidance grounded in that data and in national technical assistance resources. The position owns the application end to end, from data processing and the user interface to its AI capabilities and their evaluation. The role involves working independently with a domain expert who calibrates the work at key milestones, and calls for sound engineering judgment, fluency with generative AI, and vigilance over the privacy of sensitive education data.
Responsible for the creation, implementation, maintenance, performance, production support and documentation of various departmental and enterprise-wide application systems. This includes but is not limited to the installation, modification, and testing of new and/or upgraded applications (packages or homegrown), operating systems, file structures, hardware, communication devices, and productivity tools. Applies analysis techniques and procedures to gather and then translate business requirements into functional/technical specifications and designs. Using functional specifications and designs, produces all or part of the deliverables. Maintains databases and application system code.
Responsible for full life cycle of medium to large sized complex projects; strong technical skills; strong ability to understand complex business processes. Develops solutions based on extensive technical knowledge, skills and experience; influences client towards innovative/integrated solutions.
## Specific Duties & Responsibilities
• The responsibilities listed below are typical examples of the work performed by this position.
• Not all duties assigned to this position are included, nor is it expected that everyone in this position will be assigned every job responsibility.
Analysis & Requirements Gathering
• Define complex business/clinical/education problems by meeting with clients to observe and understand current processes and the issues related to those processes. Provide written documentation of findings to share with the client and other IT colleagues.
• Gather complex system requirements by meeting with clients and researching existing technology to understand the business requirements and possible solutions for new applications.
Design & Development
• Develop detailed tasks and project plans by analyzing project scope and milestones for complex projects to ensure product is delivered quickly according to software lifecycle standards.
• Write functional/technical specifications from the complex system requirements, putting them into functional and technical descriptions for use by programmers and business analysts to develop technical solutions.
• Develop/change data input, files/database structures, data transformation, algorithms, and data output by using appropriate computer language/tools to provide technical solutions for complex application development tasks.
• Document code and associated processes by adhering to development methodologies, adding code comments and appropriate documentation to various knowledge-base system(s) to simplify code maintenance and to improve support.
• Provide monitoring and guidance in application design and development to more junior staff.
• Provide thought leadership in designing and developing innovative integrated solutions.
Testing & Documentation
• Create and document complex test scenarios using the appropriate testing tools to validate and verify application functionality.
• Test all changes by using the appropriate complex test scenarios to ensure all delivered solutions work as expected and errors are handled in a meaningful way.
• Author and maintain documentation by writing audience-appropriate materials to serve as technical and/or end-user references.
• Mentor junior staff in testing tools and technologies by reviewing their work.
Implementation & Maintenance
• Implement changes by adhering to the change management policies and procedures for any given project to communicate to all parties the nature, significance, and risk factors of the solution.
• Monitor changes and resolve complex problems by responding as they occur, by reviewing all processing and output of the newly implemented solution, and by proactively ensuring the solution works successfully to satisfy the customer requirements and to provide a smooth transition to the new solution.
• Provide support by investigating and resolving issues, including complex issues to ensure prompt, effective service.
In addition to the duties described above
• Application Development: Design, build, maintain, and document an AI-powered data application, from data intake and processing to the interface practitioners use to explore their data.
• AI Capabilities: Design and build the generative AI features, including retrieval-augmented generation over authoritative domain sources, that help practitioners interpret their data and receive evidence-grounded answers to their questions.
• Evaluation and Quality: Establish how the system's outputs are measured and improved over time and pair quantitative evaluation with review by domain experts.
• Privacy and Responsible Use: Design for the privacy of sensitive personally identifiable information and for the responsible, cost-effective use of AI services.
• Collaboration: Work closely with the Frontend UX Engineer and domain experts to align the application's data, AI features, and interface with the needs of practitioners.
Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree (or foreign equivalent) in computer science, computer information systems, information technology, electronic engineering, or a related field.
• Five years of related work experience with computer systems and applications.
• Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond HS Diploma/Graduation Equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.
Preferred Qualifications

• 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building data-driven applications (e.g., in Python).

• Demonstrated experience designing LLM-powered features (e.g., prompt engineering, tool-using agents).
• Experience building and deploying web applications (e.g., React, serverless functions on Netlify or AWS Lambda).
• Experience evaluating AI systems with both quantitative measures and human review (e.g., faithfulness and relevancy metrics, review by domain experts).
• Strong understanding of privacy and security practices for sensitive data (e.g., data minimization, API key management).
