É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.
## Vem fazer beleza com a gente!
Como Analytics Engineer III na diretoria de Dados do Grupo Boticário, você será o elo técnico entre a Plataforma de Dados e as áreas de negócio de FP&A.
No dia a dia, você vai:
• Liderar a modelagem de dados:Desenhar e manter camadas de dados robustas, garantindo que as regras de negócio sejam traduzidas em código limpo, eficiente e versionado.
• Garantir a confiabilidade:Implementar testes de dados automatizados, monitoramento de qualidade e documentação técnica, assegurando que indicadores críticos de segurança e eficácia do produto sejam 100% confiáveis.
• Otimizar performance:Atuar na melhoria de performance de queries e pipelines, garantindo escalabilidade para o grande volume de dados do Grupo.
• Atuar como parceiro de negócio:Colaborar ativamente com Product Managers e Analistas Funcionais para entender dores complexas e propor soluções de arquitetura de dados proativas.
• Disseminar cultura de dados:Mentorar membros mais juniores do time (code reviews, boas práticas) e promover a cultura de Self-Service para os stakeholders de negócio.
• Pensamento Crítico e Resolução de Problemas:Capacidade de ir além da solicitação inicial, investigando a causa raiz das dores de negócio para propor arquiteturas que resolvam o problema real. Atuar ativamente nas discussões, questionando premissas e sugerindo melhorias proativas nos processos e na esteira de desenvolvimento do time.
Para esta posição de Analytics Engineer III, buscamos alguém com conhecimento técnico em arquitetura de dados moderna e que atue como referência técnica para o time, garantindo a escalabilidade e a governança dos dados de QEC.
O que é indispensável (Must-haves):
Análise de Requisitos e Autonomia: Capacidade de atuar diretamente com o time funcional para liderar o levantamento de requisitos, traduzir necessidades de negócio em escopo técnico e conduzir a execução das demandas de ponta a ponta com independência.
Domínio Avançado de SQL: Experiência comprovada na escrita de queries complexas e performáticas para transformação de dados no Google BigQuery.
Modelagem de Dados: Sólida experiência com modelagem dimensional, criação de tabelas otimizadas para consumo analítico e arquiteturas modernas de dados (Data Lakehouse), traduzindo regras de negócio em esquemas técnicos eficientes.
Cloud GCP: Conhecimento nos serviços do Google Cloud Platform, especialmente em estratégias de armazenamento e processamento.
Orquestração de Pipelines: Experiência prática com ferramentas de orquestração de fluxo de dados (Airflow) para gerenciar dependências, agendamentos e monitoramento de falhas.
Engenharia de Software aplicada a Dados: Vivência com versionamento de código (Git), Code Reviews, Pull Requests e esteiras de CI/CD.
O que vai fazer os olhos brilharem (Diferenciais):
IA Generativa e Agentes: Uso prático de ferramentas de GenAI (Gemini, Copilot, Cursor, etc) para acelerar o desenvolvimento de código ou experiência na implementação de agentes de IA para automação de tarefas, qualidade de dados e integração de agentes nos pipelines de dados.
Python: Proficiência em Python para automação de scripts, orquestração ou análises exploratórias.
Ingestão via APIs: Experiência em extrações de dados via APIs de terceiros (ex: Google, Meta, Salesforce, etc.), lidando com autenticação, paginação e cargas incrementais.
FinOps e Otimização: Experiência monitorando custos de processamento e latência, atuando proativamente na refatoração de queries para eficiência de custos na nuvem.
Conhecimentos avançados em dados: Conhecimentos em ciência de dados, modelos estatísticos e machine learning são considerados diferenciais para a posição.

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

title: AI Solution Development Consultant- Forward Deployed
description:
## Summary
As part of Workiva's Growth Solutions team, the AI Solution Development Consultant is forward-deployed with clients. You help enterprise customers solve complex reporting, regulatory, and business process challenges by designing, configuring, and delivering AI-powered solutions on the Workiva platform. This hands-on, client-facing role combines consultative problem-solving, enterprise software configuration, and applied AI. You work directly with clients to understand how their processes operate, find where they can improve, and turn those needs into working solutions using existing and emerging platform capabilities.
You are equally comfortable facilitating a client workshop, turning business requirements into a solution design, and configuring and deploying that solution yourself. You understand how AI, including agents and intelligent automation, applies to enterprise workflows, and you have practical experience turning those opportunities into solutions that real clients use. The work happens where client requirements, platform capabilities, and emerging AI meet. You decide how to deliver value today and help shape the reusable solutions of tomorrow. You do this in regulated environments, so governance, auditability, and scalability matter as much as speed.
## This role is/is not
## This role is
• Client-facing and consultative, with ownership of outcomes
• Hands-on configuration of a platform that is not turnkey
• Practical application of AI and agents inside real client processes
## This role is not
• A pure software engineering role
• A pre-sales or demo role
• An advisory role that stops at the recommendation
## What you'll do
## Run discovery that ends in a design
• Lead workshops and working sessions with regulatory, finance, tax, and IT stakeholders. For example, sit with a tax team to map how a country-by-country report is assembled today, then leave with a documented process and a clear view of what the platform covers and what it does not.
## Configure the solution yourself
• Design, build, and test client-specific solutions on the Workiva platform. For example, set up the forms, data structures, business rules, and workflow for a regulatory filing, and connect it to the client's ERP data.
## Put AI to work inside the process
• Identify where AI and agents improve how clients run reporting and compliance workflows, then configure and deploy them. For example, build an agent that drafts a first pass of a disclosure from source data, with a human review step, an exception queue, and an audit trail.
## Take it live and make it stick
• Own the outcome through validation, deployment, and adoption. For example, run testing with the client's preparers and reviewers, fix what breaks, and measure cycle time and error rates after go-live. Serve as the trusted advisor throughout, and be clear about trade-offs.
## Turn client work into reusable patterns
• Capture what works so the next engagement starts further ahead. For example, document a configuration pattern from one client for the team's shared knowledge base, and log a platform gap with evidence for Product and Engineering.
## What you'll need
## Minimum qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.
• 5+ years in client-facing enterprise software consulting, implementation, or solution development, with hands-on involvement in delivering to clients.
• 5+ years of experience working with enterprise software architecture, data flows, APIs, and system integrations, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
## Preferred qualifications
• Experience with regulatory reporting processes, such as financial, sustainability, tax transparency, or statutory reporting, or related audit, risk, and compliance work.
• Experience configuring enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, or Workiva.
• Experience with ERP and finance systems such as SAP or Oracle, and an understanding of how upstream data quality and structure shape reporting outcomes.
• Practical experience designing or configuring AI agents and workflows, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, output evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
• Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or JavaScript for scripting, data manipulation, or integration.
• Experience working with Product Management and Engineering to turn client requirements into reusable capabilities.
• Experience alongside implementation partners, systems integrators, advisory firms, or audit firms.
## Travel and working conditions
• Up to 25% travel for client engagements and internal meetings.
• Reliable internet access when working remotely or outside a Workiva office.
## How You’ll Be Rewarded
✅ Salary range in the US: $111,000.00 - $180,000.00
✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually
✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire
✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package
The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.
## Why Join Workiva
Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.
At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.
Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.
Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .
Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.
Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

title: Platform Engineer - AI
description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.
## About the role
HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.
## What you will do
• Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,
and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.
• Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering
leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is
reproducible and version controlled.
• Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature
flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us
how it behaves there.
• Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established
application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that
has to be preserved.
• Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they
live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match
## the existing ones.
• Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and
much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.
• Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis
through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.
## What we are looking for
You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the
tools from day one.
Where you need depth
• Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe
and defend.
• Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error
handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a
language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.
• Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub
Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers
to be shipped.
Where working knowledge is enough
• Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
• Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and
containers.
• Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production
monitoring and alerting.
Across everything
• Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
• Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,
and careful, staged rollout.
• Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is
written.
• Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work
with your counterparts rather than around them.
## Nice to have
• Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,
wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the
## domain to the right engineer.
• Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
• AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
• Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.
## Recruitment Notice
TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.
Beware of Recruitment Scams
We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.
## Protect yourself by following these steps:
• Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.
• Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
• If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to and/or report it to the platform where you received it.
Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

title: Data Scientist
description:
## Job Title
## Data Scientist
## Hiring Manager
## David Corney
## Salary
## £41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experience
## Location
Remote first within the UK. We work primarily from home but also have an office available in Central London for quarterly in-person meetings with the AI team and with meetings with the rest of Full Fact. You can expect to travel to the office at least 4 times per year.
Please note that we do not hold a UKVI Sponsorship Licence, so we cannot consider sponsoring a visa applicant or issuing a Certificate of Sponsorship.
## Reporting to
## Senior Data Scientist
## Employment Type
## Permanent
We are happy to talk about flexible working, including part time.
## Application Closing Date
## 10 am on Monday 30 November 2026.
## Introduction to the role
At a moment when our information environment is under significant strain, this is an exciting opportunity: a role with real autonomy, meaningful mission, and genuine influence at the intersection of AI and web scale engineering.
As a Data Scientist at Full Fact, you will make sure those who make false claims in public can't get away with it. This is a rare opportunity to work for a non-profit tackling internet-scale misinformation problems with a global user base. The fact checks our users publish are seen hundreds of millions of times each year and embedded in many of the most well-known internet services.
Every day, 100s of people around the world find, check, archive and challenge false claims identified by AI-enabled products produced by Full Fact. Your job will be to help us improve and expand this software for our growing user base. You’ll be working at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and real-world impact.
Whether you're responding to a new feature request from users in Nigeria covering a general election, helping fact checkers in Australia verify politicians' claims in real time, or enabling health-focused charities to identify and reduce harmful content spreading online, you will be working at pace on projects that make a substantial difference in the world. In this role that means prototyping and developing features with robust APIs, writing clean Python, and working closely with engineers and other data scientists to bring AI-powered features into production.
It is an exciting time to join Full Fact. You will be joining a team of technical, data, and product specialists working on genuinely novel problems in applied AI, from natural language processing and claim detection to trust benchmarks and harm detection.
We will support you to keep learning, and if you are interested in applying but not sure you have all the skills, please do apply. We are open both to supporting learning on the job and to rearranging tasks within the team to suit the skillsets of the best applicant
## Job Definition
As an experienced Data Scientist, you will be a key contributor to a number of new and ongoing projects. You will use your technical skills to design and develop software that identifies and counters misinformation. You will develop and use a variety of datasets to train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with non-technical colleagues and other users of our tools. You will participate in code review, both of your own and of others' code.
## Outcomes
Some of the projects you will be contributing to include:
Extending our new “Public Interest AI Trust Benchmark” to provide a deeper analysis of how reliably AI chatbots answer everyday questions.
Spotting potentially misleading and harmful claims across a broad range of media
Identifying and characterising potentially harmful narratives as they spread
Helping to integrate the technologies you build into products that will have an immediate use, for both fact checkers and journalists
Identifying sightings of previously checked claims at real-time speed
## Measuring and improving the quality of the system
## What we are looking for from you
## Political impartiality and sensitivity:
You are committed to the political neutrality of our work and have a good understanding of impartiality (please see the rules on our website).
Understanding of public debate in the UK and sensitivity to the political context we work in.
## Skills/competencies
Software engineering for data science. You are familiar with the software development lifecycle. You can design, code, test, correct and document moderate to complex programs and scripts from agreed specifications with or without AI coding tools. You can use agreed standards and tools. Collaborate with others to review and refine specifications where appropriate.
AI and data science innovation. You are broadly familiar with recent advances in AI including LLMs. You proactively research and explore areas of innovation in our industry. You can identify the value for innovation within the organisation.
Applied maths, statistics and scientific practices. You understand and can help teams apply a range of practices. You know how to develop deeper expertise on a narrower range of specialisms. You can start to apply emerging theory to practical situations.
Developing data science capability. You promote and monitor continuous professional development within your organisation. You know how to develop knowledge of cutting-edge techniques and share this knowledge. You can develop and support data science capability across the organisation.
Domain expertise. You can create automated fact-checking products that are proportionate to the operational benefit and achieve significant impact. You know how to present analysis and visualisations in clear ways to communicate complex messages. You can develop data science communication skills within your team. You support the evolution of data governance and take responsibility for applying ethical data science.
Understanding analysis across the product life cycle. You understand and can help teams apply a range of techniques to analyse data and provide insight. You are proactive and can present compelling findings that inform wider decisions. You are starting to apply innovative approaches to resolve problems.
## What we offer
A salary between £41,000 - £50,000 per year depending on experience.
## Workplace Pension
## Generous holidays:
## 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
In addition, we usually close the office for a period between Christmas and New Year.
Comfortable, centrally located London office with good transport links
## Employee Assistance Programme
## Emergency Housing Loan and support for moving home
## Volunteering day
## How to apply
Upload your CV and cover letter using the link below by 10 am on Monday 30 November.
Our recruitment platform will remove identifying details such as email addresses to allow us to sift applications anonymously.
Before applying, please read the requirements we place on staff to protect Full Fact’s independence and non-partisanship
## How the application process will work
We want to see you at your best to understand your strengths and the contribution you could make at Full Fact with strong support, including for your learning and development. We also want to make sure that we use your time well during this process and don’t ask for more from you than we need to. We will make any reasonable adjustments we need to make to this process to help ensure you can perform at your best. For more information about this before applying, please .
The interview panel will be Ellie Ashman (Head of AI), David Corney (Senior Data Scientist), and James McMinn (Senior Engineer).
The process starts off with an anonymised covering letter and CV. This will be read by at least two people to produce a shortlist for the panel interview.
The first round interviews will be an audio (not video) interview, lasting no more than half an hour, at a time that’s convenient for you. We will record it so at least two people can review each interview to decide who we invite back for the second round. The recordings will be deleted at the end of the process.
The second round will include a structured interview during which you will be asked to present some of your recent work in any way you choose. The interview will be with the full panel by video and last no more than an hour. We’ll tell you everything you need to know to prepare in advance.

title: Projektleiter Microsoft Cloud und AI
description:
## Worum geht es:
Bei Experts Inside leitest du Microsoft Cloud und AI Projekte, die echte Geschäftsprozesse verändern, nicht nur Lizenzrollouts. Ob M365 Migration, Azure Projekt, Copilot Einführung oder Agentic AI Implementierung: Du hältst die Fäden zusammen, steuerst die Teams und trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass Projekte in Zeit, Budget und Qualität beim Kunden ankommen.
## Deine Aufgaben:
Projektleitung M365 & Copilot: Du planst, steuerst und lieferst Microsoft 365 Rollouts und Copilot Einführungen, vom Kickoff bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb.
Azure & AI Projekte: Du leitest Projekte auf Azure, von Landing Zones und Migrationen bis zu AI Lösungen mit Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI und Copilot Studio.
Planung & Controlling: Du erstellst Projektpläne, überwachst Budget und Ressourcen, erkennst Risiken früh und eskalierst sauber.
Stakeholder & Kommunikation: Du führst Kickoffs, Status Reviews und Lenkungsausschüsse, souverän auf C Level wie im IT Team.
Team & Steuerung: Du koordinierst interne Consultants, externe Dienstleister und Microsoft und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem gute Arbeit entsteht.
Adoption & Übergabe: Du sorgst dafür, dass Change Management mitgeplant ist und Lösungen sauber in den Betrieb übergehen.
## Deine Stärken:
Projektmanagement: Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Projektleiter im IT oder Cloud Umfeld und arbeitest mit klassischen und agilen Methoden. Erfahrung mit Kanban ist von Vorteil.
Microsoft Know how: Du kennst M365 (Teams, SharePoint, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Purview) und Azure und verstehst, was Copilot und AI für Unternehmen bedeuten.
Technisches Verständnis: Du musst kein Techniker sein, aber du hast ein gutes Grundverständnis dafür, wie AI Lösungen und Systeme zusammenspielen, und kannst Fragen aus dem technischen Team einordnen.

title: AI Solutions Engineer - Agents & Automation
description:
About Us
HeadQuarters is a global start-up that partners with US cannabis companies to provide support in finance, sales operations, and logistics. We are currently seeking an AI Solutions Engineer to join our growing product development team.
## The Role
We're hiring an engineer to design and build AI agents and automations for our external customers in the fast growing Cannabis / CPG industry. You'll partner with our team from the first conversation through delivery: understanding a customer's workflows, scoping what an agent should own, building it on top of their systems, and making sure it runs reliably in production.The most important part of this job is learning how a customer's work actually gets done: sitting with their frontline staff, earning their trust, and turning unwritten rules and exceptions into logic a system can follow.
Once an agent is live, you'll hand it off to one of our Operations Managers, who oversee the agent's day-to-day work and output on the customer's behalf.
Every customer runs on a different stack, so this role calls for real engineering depth, and you don't need a long AI resume to have it. We're looking for a strong developer who has recently put LLM-powered workflows into production. Plenty of people can prompt their way to a working prototype. We need someone who can own the code behind it, troubleshoot it inside an unfamiliar environment, and harden it so it holds up long after you've moved on to the next customer.
## What You'll Do
Discovery and Scoping (with the AI Sales Lead)
• Sit with customers' frontline staff to learn how the work actually gets done, capture the rules and exceptions that live in people's heads, and translate them into explicit logic
• Build trust with the people whose work you're automating, and treat them as the experts on their process
• Assess technical feasibility and identify which tasks are good candidates for an agent and where human review should stay in the loop
• Translate customer needs into solution designs, effort estimates, and clear scope
• Build proofs of concept and demos that show customers what an agent can do with their own workflows
• Provide build and run cost estimates (model usage, infrastructure, maintenance) to support pricing
• Join customer discovery calls to understand their workflows, systems, data, and pain points
Build and Deploy
• Design, build, and deploy AI agents and automations that handle multi-step workflows across customer operations
• Build and configure integrations that link each customer's tools, such as CRMs, ERPs, accounting platforms, email, messaging, and document storage, using APIs where they exist and browser automation where they don't
• Write production-quality Python for integrations, data transformation, and agent tooling
• Use SQL to validate agent outputs, reconcile records across systems, and measure accuracy
• Build error handling, retries, idempotency, logging, alerting, and graceful fallbacks into everything you ship
• Create testing and evaluation processes for each agent: test sets, regression checks, and accuracy tracking before go-live and after every change
• Architect deployments so each customer's data, credentials, and permissions stay fully isolated
Handoff and Support

• Operator empathy: you build trust with frontline staff, treat them as the experts on their work, and explain technical tradeoffs in plain language

title: AI Scientist (LATAM)
description:
## Build a Safer World.
TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.
TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions, including our AI investigations platform Ardence, that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime and global security threats. At TRM, you'll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily.
As an AI Scientist on our new AI Research team, you will build the models and agents behind the intelligence that powers TRM's products. Part of that is training foundation models on blockchain data, one of our most differentiated data layers, and part is building autonomous AI agents that generate intelligence at a scale hand-built heuristics cannot reach. You'll work on Intel Cortex and other ambitious, cross-cutting ideas, with a broad view across intelligence rather than a single risk category. This is pioneering work that does not exist elsewhere in our industry, and it directly drives customer outcomes, from seizing illicit funds to disrupting criminal networks.
The impact you'll have here:
Train ML models on blockchain data, including foundation models, and take them from research to production.
Build AI agents (and fine-tune LLMs where it helps) so the intelligence underneath TRM's products is generated by models and agents, not only hand-built heuristics.
Find new ways to generate net new intelligence, using patterns across all intelligence layers (Network / On-chain / Protocol) that competitors can't replicate.
Ship production-quality code: ML models, agents and data pipelines, with rigorous evaluation and scalable architecture.
Take on ambitious, high-impact bets that raise the ceiling of what our intelligence can do, and drive measurable outcomes: billions in illicit funds traced, seized, or prevented.
What we’re looking for:
Quantitative background (Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics). Advanced degree or equivalent research experience is a plus.
Strong machine learning foundations, built over years of applied ML and/or research (modeling, evaluation, experimentation). You don't need to have trained a foundation model or built agents before, but you need the fundamentals to do it.
Strong problem-solving mindset: gets to the root cause, leverages creativity, and thrives in ambiguity with a hypothesis-driven, iterative approach.
5+ years of hands-on machine learning experience, with strong Python, SQL, and AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code).
Experience with distributed data systems (Spark, BigQuery, Airflow) and shipping production ML code.
Strong async communication (Loom, Slack, Notion), strong technical communication in English, and ability to own work independently in a remote environment.
Bonus: experience with LLMs, AI agents or fine-tuning; domain curiosity or prior work in blockchain, crypto, fraud, money laundering or financial crime.
About the Team:
AI Research is a new team focused on ambitious, cross-cutting ideas in attribution and intelligence.
Fully remote and globally distributed. Most overlap occurs 7am–12pm PST for meetings and collaboration.
All team members must have at least 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.
You'll work in partnership with the category pods, whose expert-built heuristics provide the high-confidence labels our models learn from.
Learn about TRM Speed in this position:
Rapid Customer Impact. Deliver last-minute, high-stakes projects for key customers — turning around attribution insights in days, not weeks.
MVP to Production. Build complex algorithms with tight timeframes (1-2 sprints for MVP) and iterate based on real customer feedback.
Parallel Execution. Juggle multiple priorities across categories and stakeholders while maintaining quality and speed.
## Application Instructions
If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.
Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.
If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.
## Interviewing with TRM
Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.
Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!
Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.
## AI Fluency at TRM
AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.
We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.
At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:
Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage
You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.
## Life at TRM
We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.
TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.
Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
At TRM, you should expect:
Priorities and targets to change quickly
Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes
This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.
We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.
If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.
## Leadership Principles
We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.
Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.
## Join our Mission
At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.
TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.
## Privacy Policy and Additional Information
By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.
Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.
If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.
To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.
## Recruitment agencies
TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

title: Frontend Software Engineer
description:
About Wayflyer

The challenge

What you'll actually do
Provide technical leadership in architectural decisions and champion our existing frontend best practices, advocating for our standards and helping push them forward across the team
Lead the design and implementation of complex frontend features using TypeScript and React, ensuring high-quality, reusable components that scale across our financial products
Partner with product and design teams to shape product outcomes, defining intuitive experiences that help e-commerce brands access and manage their funding. This goes beyond delivering UI; every engineer here plays a meaningful role in what we build and how it serves our customers
Own end-to-end delivery: shape solutions with product/design, build and test, ship to production and monitor/iterate using our observability stack.
Drive improvements in performance, accessibility, and user experience across our platform
Mentor engineers across the team and conduct thorough code reviews to maintain high quality standards
Work closely alongside our backend engineers, contributing across the stack when needed. We actively encourage curiosity and flexibility about where you can add value
Lead technical discussions and contribute to the team's technical strategy
Identify and proactively address technical debt and system scalability challenges
Who thrives here
You should be comfortable making and defending technical decisions, while remaining open to feedback and alternative approaches. You'll need to balance technical excellence with business needs and help guide the team toward pragmatic solutions.
You excel at stakeholder management and can effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences. You're proactive in identifying and addressing potential issues before they become problems. We look for candidates with most or all of the below traits that can point to real experience applying them.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of experience with deep expertise in frontend development
Advanced proficiency in TypeScript and extensive experience with React and modern frontend architectures
Expert knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript fundamentals with a focus on performance optimisation
Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and managing complex state, including hands-on experience with TanStack Query
Experience contributing to and working with design systems
Familiarity with backend technologies (Python, Django) and a willingness to contribute across the stack. This isn’t a hard requirement, but that flexibility matters to us.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (especially GitHub Actions) and maintaining high-quality testing practices using tools like Storybook/Chromatic, Playwright, and Vitest
Proven track record of leading technical initiatives and mentoring engineers
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems
Excellent communication abilities and experience managing stakeholder relationships
Given what we do, experience in financial services, fintech and business-to-business organisations is particularly interesting to us.
We hire for range
What you're like as a person and how you treat people is a big deal for us. People love working with you. You're helpful and generous with your time and knowledge. People love helping you back. People know where they stand with you.
You're always looking to learn and grow, on a personal and professional level. And you're always looking to help others learn and grow by sharing your own knowledge and experience.
You know why diversity, equality, inclusion and belonging matters, and speak up when we can do better.
What this role could turn into
Frontend engineers here tend to grow in a few different directions: shaping architecture across multiple products, moving into staff or principal engineering tracks, or stepping into engineering management. Some engineers want to go deep on the technical track; others find their strengths pull them toward leading and growing people. We support both paths, and the direction depends on where your interests are strongest.
Location and working policy
📍Fully remote, Europe.
The good stuff
25 days off, plus public holidays. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

description:
About the team:
At SumUp, keeping our platform safe and compliant is critical to the trust of the millions of small businesses we serve around the world.
You'll join our Global AML team at an exciting point in its growth. We're expanding into new markets, evolving our AML capabilities, introducing AI-enabled controls, and navigating increasingly complex regulatory expectations.
As an AML Data Analyst, you'll play a key role in turning AML data into actionable insights. Working closely with our global AML Operations and AML Governance teams, as well as colleagues across Engineering and Data, you'll help us understand how our controls are performing, identify risks and gaps early, and make better decisions as our business scales.
This is a role where your analysis will go beyond reporting. The insights you generate will directly support how we monitor, improve, and strengthen our global AML framework.
What you'll do:
• Build and maintain AML dashboards, operational reports, and data packs used by AML Operations, AML Governance, and senior leadership
• Design measurement frameworks that track AML operational KPIs, including case volumes, productivity, SLA adherence, and screening hit rates
• Support AML teams by providing data extracts, analysis, trend identification, and root-cause analysis on AML control outputs and data quality issues
• Run data validation and quality checks to keep AML data accurate and consistent across systems and regions
• Support Transaction Monitoring and Sanctions/PEP screening through data analysis, requirements definition, and testing
• Partner with Engineering and AML Operations to define data requirements and support automation projects
• Build self-service analytics resources so AML Operations teams can explore data and find insights independently
You'll be great for this role if you have:
• Experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role within financial services, fintech, compliance, AML, or another regulated environment.
• Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries and building reliable datasets for reporting and analysis.
• Practical experience with Python for data analysis and automation.
• Experience working with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify patterns, trends, root causes, and actionable insights from complex data.
• The ability to translate technical analysis into clear recommendations and stories for non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
• Experience working with data quality, validation, multiple data sources, and competing stakeholder priorities.
• A proactive, curious mindset and interest in AML, financial crime, fintech, and emerging technologies such as AI, with the ability to take ownership in a fast-changing environment.

title: Software Engineer (gn) @ Industrial AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.
About Marentis
Marentis develops AI-supported software for manufacturing, robotics and complex automated machinery. We turn machine data and operational information into useful knowledge for troubleshooting, decision-making and automation. Our work connects sensor measurements, machine and robot states, quality data, alarms and expert knowledge. These problems require understanding both the data and its context: a fault may originate elsewhere in a production line, and similar symptoms can have different causes. We are a small, early-stage startup where individual contributions directly shape the product. We value curiosity, initiative and people who enjoy understanding difficult problems and making things work.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Software Engineer with strong Python skills and sound technical judgment. You will own backend features from problem definition through implementation, testing, deployment and maintenance.
After onboarding, you should be able to investigate unfamiliar production code and independently review Python/backend pull requests: understand intended behavior, question assumptions, assess tests and failure paths, and identify effects on the wider system.
We actively encourage AI-assisted development. You remain responsible for understanding, verifying and maintaining the resulting software. We value demonstrated delivery, ownership and learning ability more than a fixed number of years in the industry.
What You Will Do
Build backend services, APIs and SQL-backed data pipelines for industrial analytics, knowledge retrieval and agent workflows.
Read and improve existing code, review pull requests, and make informed decisions about interfaces, data models, state and failure handling.
Design meaningful unit, integration and end-to-end tests, supported by continuous integration.
Test with representative machine data, recorded streams and simulated device inputs, including missing measurements, duplicate or out-of-order events, invalid values and connection failures.
Reproduce bugs, inspect whether test assertions verify the intended behavior, and add useful regression coverage.
Understand manufacturing users and equipment, contribute across integration and deployment, and communicate trade-offs and blockers early.
What You Bring
Strong practical Python and backend engineering skills, supported by software you personally shipped and maintained.
Independent code-review ability: you can investigate a change, assess correctness, maintainability and security, and justify whether it is ready to merge.
Practical system-design judgment across APIs, SQL, database design, data validation, state management and concurrency where relevant.
Strong testing and debugging skills: you choose useful test boundaries, construct representative data and investigate failures.
Experience making imperfect operational, machine, sensor or similarly complex data trustworthy, with an interest in its industrial meaning and consequences.
Resourcefulness: you learn unfamiliar code and technologies through documentation, small experiments, focused questions and feedback.
Clear written and spoken English, constructive collaboration and reliable follow-through.
We welcome different educational and professional paths. Direct manufacturing experience is especially useful; equivalent engineering depth from adjacent domains is also relevant.
Particularly Relevant Experience
Bring depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in all of them is not expected.
Machine data, analytics and machine learning: Time-series or sensor-data processing, curation, feature engineering, anomaly detection, condition monitoring or quality prediction. Explain how you handled timestamps, units, asset identity and data quality, and evaluated whether the result was useful.
Knowledge graphs and retrieval: Entity and relationship modeling, graph or relational database design, provenance, versioning and conflicting information. Experience combining identifiers, aliases, lexical search and semantic retrieval, with evaluations of relevance and applicability.
Agent systems and workflows: LLM tools, multi-agent coordination, orchestration, context and memory management, validation and failure recovery. Show how you evaluated quality, cost and latency, enforced permissions and chose appropriate execution boundaries.
Industrial integration, robotics and automation: Connecting software with production equipment, robot cells or automated machinery through telemetry, device interfaces or protocols such as MQTT and OPC UA. Experience with simulators, physical-device testing and equipment-specific behavior is valuable.
Cloud deployment, containerization, observability and operating software across customer environments are also useful.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer      

 

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

 

The role

We're looking for a Data Engineer to help build scalable data solutions that serve teams across the business—from data scientists and analysts to AI engineers and product teams. You'll contribute to both the underlying platform and the way data is used in our products, working in a modern, cloud-native environment where privacy, security, and good data practices are part of how we build.

 

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Technical Expertise: 3+ years building and shipping production-grade data systems, with strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or another object-oriented language (Java, Scala etc.)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure—ideally some exposure to Terraform, Kubernetes, or similar IaC and container orchestration tools. We don't expect deep expertise in all of these, but comfort working in this kind of environment matters.
  • Experience designing data APIs or services that expose data to applications, or a strong interest in working across the analytical/operational boundary.
  • A thoughtful approach to data quality, privacy, and security—you understand that how data is used is as important as how it's moved.
  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort working across teams with different priorities—engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, and product.
  • A pragmatic, curious mindset—you enjoy keeping up with the field and know when to reach for a new tool versus when to stick with what works.
  • Pipeline Management: Hands-on experience with data pipeline tools (Airflow, dbt) and strong ability to optimize for performance and reliability.
  • Quality Focus: Commitment to continuously improving product quality, security, and performance through rigorous testing and code reviews.
  • Documentation: Meticulous approach to creating and maintaining architecture and systems documentation.
  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical skills to troubleshoot complex data issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Independence: Capability to ship medium features independently while contributing to the team's overall objectives.

 

What you’ll be doing in the role 

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that power analytics, ML workloads, and product-facing applications—from internal databases, SaaS sources, and streaming systems through to the teams and services that consume them.
  • Evolve our data platform alongside cloud platform engineers, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes-based deployments (Argo) to keep the platform scalable, reliable, and self-serve.
  • System Architecture: Design and implement scalable data infrastructure that accommodates our growing data volume and complexity.
  • Develop data services and APIs that expose trusted data to product applications, bridging analytical and operational systems.
  • Own data quality and observability, putting monitoring, testing, and alerting in place so issues are caught early and trust in the data stays high.
  • Partner with AI engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product teams to understand their data needs and design the right solutions—not just the quickest ones.
  • Uphold strong data privacy, security, and compliance practices in everything you build, particularly where data flows into product-facing contexts.
  • Technical Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of data flows, models, and systems for knowledge sharing.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure all data systems adhere to security best practices and compliance requirements.

 

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.
